title: Refund policy sekolah partner Talented (ringkasan dari dokumen resmi sekolah)
disclaimer: Ringkasan saja; yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah. Bila sekolah membatalkan kursus, siswa dilindungi ESOS & Tuition Protection Service. New Zealand: biaya siswa internasional dilindungi aturan NZQA (fee protection) dan Education and Training Act 2020; yang berlaku adalah offer letter/ketentuan sekolah.
fallback_text: Refund policy belum tercantum di situs resmi sekolah - perlu konfirmasi ke sekolah atau cek refund policy di offer letter nanti.

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund semua biaya kursus dipotong 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur sebelum mulai: 70% (4 minggu atau lebih sebelum mulai) atau 50% (kurang dari 4 minggu), biaya enrolment dan COE tidak dikembalikan; setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Refused before start (or withdraws on/before start day because of refusal): total course fees received minus 5% of course fees or AUD 500, whichever is less. Refused after start: weekly tuition fee x weeks in default period. No refund if refusal results from not starting, withdrawing or not paying.
items.withdraw_before_start: 'Up to 4 weeks prior to course commencement' (as worded): 70% of all fees except enrolment and COE fee. Less than 4 weeks prior: 50% of all fees except enrolment and COE fee. Does not start and has not withdrawn: no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund; fees for the full study period (term) remain payable.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee and COE fee (on pre-start withdrawal); application fee non-refundable except if college cancels course before commencement.
items.provider_default: Before commencement: full refund of all fees. After commencement: refund of unspent fees (weekly fee x weeks in default period). Automatic, within 10 working days; otherwise Tuition Protection Service.
items.document: Fees Charges & Refunds Policy (Logic Entity Australia t/a Abbey College Australia, CRICOS 02658G, RTO 91136) - Version 4.0, updated July 2026
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: refund of all course fees minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal before start: 70% (4 weeks or more before start) or 50% (less than 4 weeks); enrolment and COE fees are not refunded; no refund after start. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 70% (4 สัปดาห์ขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน) หรือ 50% (น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์); ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน (enrolment fee) และค่า COE; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ học phí khóa học trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70% (từ 4 tuần trở lên trước khi khai giảng) hoặc 50% (dưới 4 tuần); phí ghi danh và phí COE không được hoàn; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还全部课程费用，扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前退学：退还 70%（开课前 4 周或以上）或 50%（不足 4 周）；注册费和 COE 费用不予退还；开课后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：全コース費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始前の取り下げ：70%（開始の4週間以上前）または50%（4週間未満）。入学金とCOE費用は返金されません。開始後の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 전체 코스 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 70%(개강 4주 이상 전) 또는 50%(4주 미만 전) 환불되며, 입학금(enrolment fee)과 COE 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងប្រាក់វិញនូវថ្លៃវគ្គសិក្សាទាំងអស់ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 70% (4 សប្តាហ៍ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន) ឬ 50% (តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍); ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន និងថ្លៃ COE មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退款扣除费用的 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）；需提供拒签证明。开课前 >4 周退学：退还 70% 学费；≤4 周：50%；开课后不予退款；申请费和教材费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：費用の5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金。却下の証明が必要です。開始の4週間超前の取り下げ：授業料の70%を返金。4週間以内：50%。開始後の返金はありません。出願料と教材費は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 비용의 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, 거절 증빙이 필요합니다. 개강 4주 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료 70% 환불, 4주 이하: 50% 환불, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비(application fee)와 교재비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងប្រាក់វិញ ដកចេញ 5% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ត្រូវមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធ។ ការដកខ្លួន >4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 70%; ≤4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ និងថ្លៃសម្ភារៈ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai (dengan bukti), biaya dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur lebih dari 4 minggu sebelum mulai refund 70% tuition, 4 minggu atau kurang refund 50%; setelah mulai tidak ada refund; application fee, biaya admin dan material fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before course start: tuition and non-tuition fees received refunded less 5% of course fees received or AUD 500, whichever is less; proof of refusal and evidence of payment required. Visa refused after course start: refund = weekly tuition fee x weeks in default period. No refund if the student defaulted (did not start, withdrew, or did not pay).
items.withdraw_before_start: Based on email notification date: more than 4 weeks before commencement – 70% refund of tuition fees paid in advance; 4 weeks or less before commencement – 50% refund of tuition fees paid in advance.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of tuition fees paid in advance. At least one full term's written notice required; with shorter notice the following term's fees are payable.
items.non_refundable: Administration fees and fees such as the Application Fee (unless stated otherwise); fees paid to other providers such as Material Fee unless goods/services not provided. No refund on expulsion.
items.provider_default: If the College defaults (course not starting on agreed day, ceasing, sanction): TPS Director and students notified within 3 business days; student may choose an alternative course at no extra cost or refund of all unspent tuition fees within two weeks of the course ceasing; TPS placement if not possible.

items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start (with proof), fees are refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal more than 4 weeks before start: 70% tuition refund; 4 weeks or less: 50% refund; no refund after start; application fee, admin fee and material fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน (มีหลักฐาน) จะคืนค่าเรียนหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวมากกว่า 4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 70%; 4 สัปดาห์หรือน้อยกว่า: คืน 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร ค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ (admin fee) และค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng (có bằng chứng), học phí được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học hơn 4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70% học phí; từ 4 tuần trở xuống: hoàn 50%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí nộp hồ sơ, phí hành chính và phí tài liệu không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒（需提供证明），退还费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前超过 4 周退学：退还 70% 学费；4 周或以内：退还 50%；开课后不予退款；申请费、行政费和教材费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合（証明あり）、費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始の4週間超前の取り下げ：授業料の70%を返金。4週間以内：50%を返金。開始後の返金はありません。出願料、事務手数料、教材費は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우(증빙 제출 시), 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 4주 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료 70% 환불, 4주 이하: 50% 환불, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비, 행정비, 교재비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន (មានភស្តុតាង) ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 70%; 4 សប្តាហ៍ ឬតិចជាងនេះ៖ សងវិញ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល និងថ្លៃសម្ភារៈ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Academy of Interactive Technology Pty Ltd (AIT, also t/a Greenwich Higher Education, Coder Academy), CRICOS 02155J; Sydney Level 2, 7 Kelly St Ultimo; Melbourne Level 13, 120 Spencer St
items.summary_id: Kebijakan AIT tidak mengatur khusus refund jika visa ditolak. Jika mundur dengan pemberitahuan tertulis sebelum census date, uang kuliah periode tersebut dapat dikembalikan; setelah census date tidak ada refund. Biaya pendaftaran (enrolment fee) tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: not stated
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice before the census date: eligible for refund of paid tuition fees (no percentage stated). No refund if student fails to start on agreed day, or withdraws before start while owing an unpaid amount.
items.withdraw_after_start: Notice before the census date of a study period: refund of tuition paid for that period plus unused prepaid tuition. After the census date: no refund for that study period (discretionary full/partial refund for documented extenuating circumstances).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee is non-refundable (amount not stated; may be waived in Letter of Offer).
items.provider_default: If AIT fails to provide the course, refund paid within 20 business days.
items.document: AIT - Fees, Cancellations, Withdrawals and Refunds Policy (linked from https://ait.edu.au/policies-and-procedures/) - Version 2.3, approved 18 September 2025
items.summary_en: AIT's policy has no specific rule on refunds if the visa is refused. If you withdraw with written notice before the census date, tuition for that period can be refunded; no refund after the census date. The enrolment fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: นโยบายของ AIT ไม่มีข้อกำหนดเฉพาะเรื่องการคืนเงินกรณีวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ หากถอนตัวโดยแจ้งเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษรก่อน census date จะได้รับคืนค่าเล่าเรียนของช่วงเวลานั้น; ไม่คืนเงินหลัง census date ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน (enrolment fee) ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Chính sách của AIT không có quy định cụ thể về hoàn tiền khi visa bị từ chối. Nếu bạn rút học bằng thông báo bằng văn bản trước census date, học phí của kỳ đó có thể được hoàn; không hoàn tiền sau census date. Phí ghi danh không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: AIT 的政策对签证被拒时的退款没有具体规定。如在 census date 之前以书面形式通知退学，可退还该学期的学费；census date 之后不予退款。注册费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: AITのポリシーには、ビザが却下された場合の返金に関する具体的な規定はありません。census date より前に書面で取り下げを通知した場合、その期間の授業料は返金される可能性があります。census date 以降の返金はありません。入学金は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: AIT의 규정에는 비자 거절 시 환불에 관한 구체적인 규정이 없습니다. census date 이전에 서면 통지로 철회하면 해당 기간의 수업료를 환불받을 수 있으며, census date 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: គោលនយោបាយរបស់ AIT មិនមានច្បាប់ជាក់លាក់អំពីការសងប្រាក់វិញ ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធទេ។ ប្រសិនបើអ្នកដកខ្លួនដោយមានការជូនដំណឹងជាលាយលក្ខណ៍អក្សរមុនថ្ងៃ census date ថ្លៃសិក្សាសម្រាប់រយៈពេលនោះអាចត្រូវបានសងវិញ; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយថ្ងៃ census date ទេ។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.pricelist_name: AISCE (Australian International College of Skill & Education)
items.official_name: Australian International College of Skills & Education Pty Ltd (AICSE)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum kursus dimulai, AICSE mengembalikan 100% biaya kuliah yang belum terpakai kecuali enrolment fee ($350, tidak dapat dikembalikan). Mundur lebih dari 28 hari sebelum mulai mendapat refund penuh biaya kuliah, kurang dari 28 hari 50%, dan setelah kursus dimulai tidak ada refund kecuali sakit serius/kesulitan berat. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refusal before course start: 100% of unused prepaid tuition fees refunded, excluding the enrolment fee. Visa refusal after start: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 28 days before start date: full tuition fees refunded minus enrolment fee. Less than 28 days before start: 50% of tuition fees minus enrolment fee.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund unless due to serious illness or hardship (compassionate/compelling circumstances assessed case by case; may be partial refund or 12-month credit). No refund if visa cancelled due to student's actions.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee $350 ('non-refundable under all circumstances'); RPL application fees; administration fees; fees for services already rendered; textbooks/materials already supplied.
items.provider_default: Automatic refund (no application needed) of unused tuition, materials not provided and training hours not delivered if AICSE ceases delivery, makes a material change without a revised agreement, or cancels a course; TPS may offer an alternative course or refund of unspent prepaid tuition. Timeframe stated inconsistently (28 calendar days / 28 business days).
items.document: AICSE Student Handbook 2026-27 (Fee and Refund Policy section) - V2.1 (per file name), 2026-27; uploaded October 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before the course starts, AICSE refunds 100% of unused tuition fees except the enrolment fee ($350, non-refundable). Withdrawal more than 28 days before start: full tuition refund; less than 28 days: 50%; no refund after the course starts except for serious illness/severe hardship. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มหลักสูตร AICSE จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ใช้ 100% ยกเว้นค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ($350 ไม่สามารถขอคืนได้) ถอนตัวมากกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนเต็มจำนวน; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร ยกเว้นกรณีเจ็บป่วยร้ายแรง/ประสบความเดือดร้อนอย่างหนัก ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khóa học bắt đầu, AICSE hoàn 100% học phí chưa sử dụng, trừ phí ghi danh ($350, không hoàn lại). Rút học hơn 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ học phí; dưới 28 ngày: 50%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khóa học bắt đầu, trừ trường hợp bệnh nặng/hoàn cảnh đặc biệt khó khăn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如课程开始前签证被拒，AICSE 退还 100% 未使用的学费，注册费（$350，不可退）除外。开课前超过 28 天退学：全额退还学费；不足 28 天：50%；课程开始后不予退款，严重疾病/严重困难情况除外。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: コース開始前にビザが却下された場合、AICSEは入学金（$350、返金不可）を除き、未使用の授業料を100%返金します。開始の28日超前の取り下げ：授業料を全額返金。28日未満：50%。コース開始後は、重い病気・深刻な困窮の場合を除き返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 코스 시작 전 비자가 거절된 경우, AICSE는 입학금($350, 환불 불가)을 제외한 미사용 수업료를 100% 환불합니다. 개강 28일 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료 전액 환불, 28일 미만: 50% 환불, 코스 시작 후에는 중병/심각한 어려움의 경우를 제외하고 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើម AICSE សងវិញ 100% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើ លើកលែងតែថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន ($350 មិនអាចសងវិញបាន)។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញទាំងស្រុង; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើមទេ លើកលែងតែករណីជំងឺធ្ងន់ធ្ងរ/ការលំបាកធ្ងន់ធ្ងរ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: ANIT Australia Pty Ltd (trading as Albright Institute of Business and Language / Albright Institute of English)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Albright mengembalikan biaya yang diterima dikurangi application/admission fee serta 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur lebih dari 4 minggu sebelum mulai mendapat 80% biaya kuliah term tersebut dikurangi application fee dan biaya admin AUD 550; kurang dari 4 minggu tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before start: total fees received refunded minus Application and Admission Fees and the lesser of 5% of total fees received or AUD 500, within 28 working days of a complete signed form with the government refusal letter. After start (visa extension not granted): calculated under the ESOS refund specification.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 4 calendar weeks before CoE start date: 80% of tuition paid for the term/study period plus other unused tuition, less application fee (AUD 200 onshore / AUD 300 offshore) and AUD 550 Refund Administration Fee. Less than 4 weeks: 0%. Withdrawal after Letter of Offer and deposit but before CoE: AUD 550 administrative fee.
items.withdraw_after_start: No separate percentage; general calculation: unused tuition minus used tuition, minus two weeks' tuition for processing, minus AUD 550. Leave of absence/deferral/suspension: 0% for the affected period.
items.non_refundable: Application and Admission Fees; ELICOS material fee once commenced; only tuition fees refundable; unsuccessful RPL 0%; OSHC/homestay/airport pick-up refunded under the service provider's policy.
items.provider_default: Full refund of unused fees within 2 weeks (stated as 10 working days) or an alternative course at no extra cost (student chooses); TPS assists if neither is possible.
items.document: PP-07 International Student Refund Policy & Procedure - v8.1, last reviewed November 2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Albright refunds the fees received minus the application/admission fee and 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal more than 4 weeks before start: 80% of that term's tuition minus the application fee and an AUD 550 admin fee; less than 4 weeks: no refund. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Albright จะคืนเงินที่ได้รับหักค่าสมัคร/ค่ารับเข้าเรียน และ 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวมากกว่า 4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 80% ของค่าเล่าเรียนเทอมนั้น หักค่าสมัครและค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 550; น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์: ไม่คืนเงิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Albright hoàn số tiền đã nhận sau khi trừ phí nộp hồ sơ/phí nhập học và 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học hơn 4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 80% học phí của kỳ đó trừ phí nộp hồ sơ và phí hành chính AUD 550; dưới 4 tuần: không hoàn tiền. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Albright 退还已收取的费用，扣除申请/入学费以及 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前超过 4 周退学：退还该学期学费的 80%，扣除申请费和 AUD 550 行政费；不足 4 周：不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Albrightは受領済みの費用から出願料/入学審査料と、5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金します。開始の4週間超前の取り下げ：その学期の授業料の80%から出願料とAUD 550の事務手数料を差し引いた額。4週間未満：返金なし。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Albright는 납부된 비용에서 지원비/입학 심사비와 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제하고 환불합니다. 개강 4주 초과 전 철회 시: 해당 학기 수업료의 80%에서 지원비와 AUD 550 행정비를 공제한 금액 환불, 4주 미만: 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Albright សងវិញនូវប្រាក់ដែលបានទទួល ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ/ថ្លៃចូលរៀន និង 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 80% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាឆមាសនោះ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ និងថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 550; តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, biaya dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil); setelah mulai hanya tuition yang belum terpakai yang dikembalikan. Mundur 12 minggu atau lebih sebelum mulai refund 100%, 5 minggu atau kurang sebelum mulai dan setelah mulai tidak ada refund; application fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before commencement (or withdrawal on/before start date due to refusal): refund of total prepaid fees minus the lesser of 5% of total prepaid fees or AUD 500. After commencement: refund of unspent tuition = weekly tuition fee x weeks remaining in default period; material fees not refundable. Evidence/time limit not specified for visa refusal (general claim rule: within 10 working days of the event).
items.withdraw_before_start: 12 or more full weeks before start: 100% of tuition and material fees refunded. 5 full weeks or less before start: no refund, full study period fees payable (enrolling within the 5-week period then withdrawing: no refund). The policy does not state the refund for withdrawal between 6 and 11 weeks before start. Not commencing on agreed date without prior withdrawal: no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund; full study period fees payable. Same if enrolment cancelled for disciplinary action, visa breach or incorrect information.
items.non_refundable: Application fees (except where ASCA cancels the course before commencement); unit repeat fee AUD 350; RPL application fee AUD 250 (if Statement of Attainment issued); material fees after commencement.
items.provider_default: Course cancelled before commencement: full refund of all fees. After commencement: refund of unspent fees (weekly tuition x weeks in default period). Automatic, no form needed; paid within 10 working days of default; students notified within 3 working days.
items.document: Fees and Refunds Policy and Associated Procedures (Alice Springs College of Australia Pty Ltd) - V1.1 effective 06/02/2026 (header shows Version 1.3)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, fees are refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less); after start, only unused tuition is refunded. Withdrawal 12 weeks or more before start: 100% refund; 5 weeks or less before start and after start: no refund; the application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าเรียนหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); หลังเริ่มเรียน คืนเฉพาะค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ใช้ ถอนตัว 12 สัปดาห์ขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 100%; 5 สัปดาห์หรือน้อยกว่าก่อนเริ่มเรียนและหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, các khoản phí được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn); sau khi khai giảng, chỉ hoàn phần học phí chưa sử dụng. Rút học từ 12 tuần trở lên trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100%; từ 5 tuần trở xuống trước khi khai giảng và sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền; phí nộp hồ sơ không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，退还费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）；开课后仅退还未使用的学费。开课前 12 周或以上退学：100% 退款；开课前 5 周或以内及开课后：不予退款；申请费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始後は未使用の授業料のみ返金されます。開始の12週間以上前の取り下げ：100%返金。開始の5週間前以内および開始後：返金なし。出願料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, 개강 후에는 미사용 수업료만 환불됩니다. 개강 12주 이상 전 철회 시: 100% 환불, 개강 5주 이하 전 및 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន មានតែថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើប៉ុណ្ណោះដែលត្រូវបានសងវិញ។ ការដកខ្លួន 12 សប្តាហ៍ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 100%; 5 សប្តាហ៍ ឬតិចជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន និងក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.withdraw_after_start: not stated (document not readable)

items.official_name: Alpha College of Australia, CRICOS 03852J, Level 5/127 Liverpool St Sydney
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, uang kuliah dikembalikan dikurangi biaya admin AUD 250. Mundur >28 hari sebelum mulai: refund 70%, ≤28 hari: 50% (dikurangi AUD 250); setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Biaya non-tuition seperti enrolment AUD 200 dan materi tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Refused before or on the agreed start date: total tuition fees received minus AUD 250 administration fee. Refused after commencement: unspent fees pro-rata (months remaining on CoE) minus AUD 250 admin fee and fees for services already provided. Evidence: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 28 days before start: 70% of total tuition fees minus AUD 250 administration fee. Within 28 days before start: 50% minus AUD 250. Not starting on agreed date without prior withdrawal: no refund (full study period fees apply).
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund; fees for the full study period (term) must be paid.
items.non_refundable: All non-tuition fees non-refundable (unless college cancels the course), e.g. enrolment fee AUD 200; enrolment variation admin fee AUD 250; visa-refusal refund admin fee AUD 250; reinstatement AUD 200; re-assessment AUD 100; materials fee as per Letter of Offer.
items.provider_default: College cancels before commencement: full refund of all fees within 14 days; after commencement: unspent fees (weekly tuition fee x weeks in default period) within 14 days; refund automatic (no form). TPS membership.
items.document: Fees and Refunds Policy - v2.0, updated 01/07/2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, tuition is refunded minus an AUD 250 admin fee. Withdrawal >28 days before start: 70% refund; ≤28 days: 50% (minus AUD 250); no refund after start. Non-tuition fees such as the AUD 200 enrolment fee and materials are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 250 ถอนตัว >28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 70%; ≤28 วัน: 50% (หัก AUD 250); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าใช้จ่ายที่ไม่ใช่ค่าเล่าเรียน เช่น ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 200 และค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, học phí được hoàn sau khi trừ phí hành chính AUD 250. Rút học >28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70%; ≤28 ngày: 50% (trừ AUD 250); không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Các khoản phí ngoài học phí như phí ghi danh AUD 200 và tài liệu không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，退还学费并扣除 AUD 250 行政费。开课前 >28 天退学：退还 70%；≤28 天：50%（扣除 AUD 250）；开课后不予退款。AUD 200 注册费和教材等非学费费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、授業料からAUD 250の事務手数料を差し引いて返金されます。開始の28日超前の取り下げ：70%返金。28日以内：50%（AUD 250差し引き）。開始後の返金はありません。AUD 200の入学金や教材費など授業料以外の費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 수업료에서 AUD 250 행정비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 초과 전 철회 시: 70% 환불, 28일 이하: 50%(AUD 250 공제), 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. AUD 200 입학금 및 교재비 등 수업료 외 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 250។ ការដកខ្លួន >28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 70%; ≤28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50% (ដកចេញ AUD 250); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃមិនមែនថ្លៃសិក្សា ដូចជាថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 200 និងសម្ភារៈ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika tidak bisa mendapat visa pelajar, sisa tuition dikembalikan penuh (dengan dokumen pendukung). Mundur >8 minggu sebelum mulai: refund penuh, >4 minggu: 80%, <4 minggu: 50%, <2 minggu: 25% dari tuition term; setelah mulai, tuition term berjalan tidak dikembalikan. Hanya tuition yang bisa di-refund; enrolment fee, OSHC, materials, homestay, dan airport pick-up tidak. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Full refund of unused tuition fees where the student cannot obtain a student visa (listed under compassionate and compelling circumstances); supporting documents required where possible. No deduction or time limit stated. Only tuition fees are refundable.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 8 weeks before CoE start date: full refund of unused tuition (compassionate circumstances). More than 4 weeks: 80% of tuition paid for the term plus other unused prepaid tuition. Less than 4 weeks: 50%. Less than 2 weeks: 25%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of current term tuition; unused prepaid tuition for future terms refunded per policy. No refund for leave/deferral/suspension period, misconduct/non-payment cancellation, or visa cancelled while in Australia.
items.non_refundable: Only tuition is refundable: OSHC, enrolment/application fees, homestay booking, airport pick-up, equipment/training materials (materials fee) are not refundable; any fee marked non-refundable in the offer/agreement; no refund for incorrect or fraudulent information.
items.provider_default: Full refund of unused tuition if course does not start on agreed date, stops before completion, is not fully provided due to regulator sanction, or college withdraws the offer.
items.document: Fee Refund Policy and Procedure - Pass Global Pty Ltd t/a ALTEC College (CRICOS 02926D) - Version 6.0, March 2021
items.summary_en: If you cannot get a student visa, remaining tuition is refunded in full (with supporting documents). Withdrawal >8 weeks before start: full refund; >4 weeks: 80%; <4 weeks: 50%; <2 weeks: 25% of the term's tuition; after start, the current term's tuition is not refunded. Only tuition is refundable; enrolment fee, OSHC, materials, homestay and airport pick-up are not. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากไม่ได้รับวีซ่านักเรียน จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนที่เหลือเต็มจำนวน (พร้อมเอกสารประกอบ) ถอนตัว >8 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวน; >4 สัปดาห์: 80%; <4 สัปดาห์: 50%; <2 สัปดาห์: 25% ของค่าเล่าเรียนเทอมนั้น; หลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าเล่าเรียนของเทอมปัจจุบัน คืนได้เฉพาะค่าเล่าเรียนเท่านั้น ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน OSHC ค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน ค่าโฮมสเตย์ และค่าบริการรับที่สนามบิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu bạn không xin được visa du học, phần học phí còn lại được hoàn đầy đủ (kèm giấy tờ chứng minh). Rút học >8 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ; >4 tuần: 80%; <4 tuần: 50%; <2 tuần: 25% học phí của kỳ học; sau khi khai giảng, học phí của kỳ hiện tại không được hoàn. Chỉ học phí được hoàn; phí ghi danh, OSHC, tài liệu, homestay và đón sân bay thì không. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如无法获得学生签证，剩余学费全额退还（需提供证明文件）。开课前 >8 周退学：全额退款；>4 周：80%；<4 周：50%；<2 周：该学期学费的 25%；开课后，当前学期学费不予退还。仅学费可退；注册费、OSHC、教材、寄宿家庭和接机费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 学生ビザが取得できなかった場合、残りの授業料が全額返金されます（裏付け書類が必要）。開始の8週間超前の取り下げ：全額返金。4週間超前：80%。4週間未満：50%。2週間未満：その学期の授業料の25%。開始後は当該学期の授業料は返金されません。返金対象は授業料のみで、入学金、OSHC、教材費、ホームステイ、空港送迎は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 학생비자를 받지 못한 경우, 남은 수업료는 전액 환불됩니다(증빙 서류 제출 시). 개강 8주 초과 전 철회 시: 전액 환불, 4주 초과: 80%, 4주 미만: 50%, 2주 미만: 해당 학기 수업료의 25% 환불, 개강 후에는 현재 학기 수업료가 환불되지 않습니다. 수업료만 환불 가능하며, 입학금, OSHC, 교재비, 홈스테이, 공항 픽업 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើអ្នកមិនអាចទទួលបានទិដ្ឋាការសិស្សទេ ថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលនៅសល់ត្រូវបានសងវិញទាំងស្រុង (មានឯកសារគាំទ្រ)។ ការដកខ្លួន >8 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង; >4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 80%; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 50%; <2 សប្តាហ៍៖ 25% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាឆមាសនោះ; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃសិក្សាឆមាសបច្ចុប្បន្នមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ មានតែថ្លៃសិក្សាប៉ុណ្ណោះដែលអាចសងវិញបាន; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន OSHC សម្ភារៈ homestay និងសេវាទទួលពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ មិនអាចសងវិញបានទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: International Institute of Management Pty Ltd T/A American College
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: semua biaya dikembalikan dikurangi application/enrolment fee AUD 395. Mundur minimal 8 minggu sebelum mulai refund penuh dikurangi AUD 395 (kurang dari 8 minggu tidak disebutkan), setelah mulai umumnya tidak ada refund; fee AUD 395 dan airport pick-up tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before commencement (offshore): all fees refunded minus non-refundable AUD 395 application/enrolment fee. After commencement (visa cancelled/refused due to student's actions): refund per refund calculator, no refund of non-tuition fees. Evidence/time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: At least 8 weeks before commencement: full refund of course fees less AUD 395 administrative fee. Less than 8 weeks: not stated.
items.withdraw_after_start: As a general rule no refund after course has commenced; exceptions considered case by case. Written notice to College Director.
items.non_refundable: Application/enrolment fee AUD 395; airport pick-up; non-tuition fees where visa cancelled due to student actions.
items.provider_default: Full refund within 14 working days if course does not start; if it stops after starting, refund per ESOS; or alternative course at no extra cost; refund no later than 28 days after course ceased (document gives differing timeframes); TPS if no alternative.
items.document: International Student Handbook (Student Handbook) - refund section - V1.2, August 2024
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: all fees refunded minus the AUD 395 application/enrolment fee. Withdrawal at least 8 weeks before start: full refund minus AUD 395 (less than 8 weeks not stated); generally no refund after start; the AUD 395 fee and airport pick-up are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักค่าสมัคร/ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 395 ถอนตัวอย่างน้อย 8 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวนหัก AUD 395 (ไม่ได้ระบุกรณีน้อยกว่า 8 สัปดาห์); โดยทั่วไปไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าธรรมเนียม AUD 395 และค่าบริการรับที่สนามบิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ phí nộp hồ sơ/ghi danh AUD 395. Rút học ít nhất 8 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ trừ AUD 395 (trường hợp dưới 8 tuần không được nêu); thông thường không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí AUD 395 và phí đón sân bay không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还全部费用，扣除 AUD 395 申请/注册费。开课前至少 8 周退学：全额退款，扣除 AUD 395（不足 8 周的情况未说明）；开课后一般不予退款；AUD 395 费用和接机费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：AUD 395の出願料/入学金を差し引いて全費用が返金されます。開始の8週間以上前の取り下げ：AUD 395を差し引いて全額返金（8週間未満については記載なし）。開始後は原則として返金なし。AUD 395の費用と空港送迎は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: AUD 395 지원비/입학금을 공제한 모든 비용이 환불됩니다. 개강 최소 8주 전 철회 시: AUD 395를 공제하고 전액 환불(8주 미만은 명시되지 않음), 개강 후에는 일반적으로 환불되지 않습니다. AUD 395 비용과 공항 픽업 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ/ចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 395។ ការដកខ្លួនយ៉ាងហោចណាស់ 8 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង ដកចេញ AUD 395 (តិចជាង 8 សប្តាហ៍ មិនបានបញ្ជាក់); ជាទូទៅមិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃ AUD 395 និងសេវាទទួលពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Analytics Institute of Australia Pty Ltd
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Analytics Institute of Australia mengembalikan biaya kuliah yang belum terpakai dikurangi $500 atau 5% (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur sebelum tanggal mulai dikenai potongan $4.000, sedangkan setelah hari pertama perkuliahan tidak ada refund; application fee tidak dapat dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: unused prepaid tuition refunded less the lesser of $500 or 5%, with documentary evidence of refusal and reason; paid within 28 days of a complete application. Continuing students (after start): same deduction if written notice given before the trimester starts.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice before agreed start date: unused prepaid tuition refunded less $4,000 (continuing students: before the trimester starts, less $4,000); paid within 28 days of a complete application.
items.withdraw_after_start: Continuing students giving written notice on or after the first day of teaching: no refund. Fees for units withdrawn after the census date are non-refundable.
items.non_refundable: Application fee (all circumstances); fees for units withdrawn after census; OSHC subject to the insurer's policy.
items.provider_default: If AIA cannot provide the course or it does not start on the agreed date: alternative course/location offered, or the student may choose a full refund of prepaid tuition, paid within 14 days; TPS assists.
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refund Policy - Version 3.0, 25 March 2024
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Analytics Institute of Australia refunds unused tuition fees minus $500 or 5% (whichever is less). Withdrawal before the start date incurs a $4,000 deduction; no refund after the first day of classes; the application fee is non-refundable. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Analytics Institute of Australia จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ใช้หักออก $500 หรือ 5% (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) การถอนตัวก่อนวันเริ่มเรียนจะถูกหัก $4,000; ไม่คืนเงินหลังวันแรกของการเรียน; ค่าสมัครไม่สามารถขอคืนได้ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Analytics Institute of Australia hoàn học phí chưa sử dụng sau khi trừ $500 hoặc 5% (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học trước ngày khai giảng sẽ bị khấu trừ $4,000; không hoàn tiền sau ngày học đầu tiên; phí nộp hồ sơ không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Analytics Institute of Australia 退还未使用的学费，扣除 $500 或 5%（以较低者为准）。开课日期前退学将扣除 $4,000；第一天上课后不予退款；申请费不可退。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Analytics Institute of Australiaは未使用の授業料から$500または5%（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金します。開始日前の取り下げには$4,000が差し引かれます。授業初日以降の返金はありません。出願料は返金不可です。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Analytics Institute of Australia는 미사용 수업료에서 $500 또는 5%(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제하고 환불합니다. 개강일 전 철회 시 $4,000가 공제되며, 수업 첫날 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Analytics Institute of Australia សងវិញនូវថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើ ដកចេញ $500 ឬ 5% (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនថ្ងៃចូលរៀនត្រូវកាត់ $4,000; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយថ្ងៃរៀនដំបូងទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យមិនអាចសងវិញបានទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Asia Pacific International College Pty Ltd (APIC)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund semua biaya dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil), wajib bukti penolakan, ajukan maksimal 6 bulan. Mundur ≥4 minggu sebelum mulai dipotong biaya 1 unit + AUD 500, <4 minggu dipotong 2 unit + AUD 500; setelah mulai umumnya tidak ada refund untuk periode berjalan; application/enrolment fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before commencement (not fraud): all course fees paid less the lesser of 5% of course fees received or AUD 500; proof of refusal required; apply up to 6 months after proposed commencement date. Visa application fee may be reimbursed up to AUD 2,500 case by case (only students from listed countries with visa approval rate above 80%, with evidence). After commencement: weekly tuition fee x weeks remaining in paid study period after default day; non-tuition fees not refunded. Fraud/misleading info: no refund.
items.withdraw_before_start: Notice of 4 or more weeks before study period start: 1 unit fee plus $500 administration fee retained, rest of prepaid tuition refunded. Within 4 weeks of start (incl. non-commencement): 2 unit fees plus $500 administration fee retained. Before CoE issued: full refund less $500 administration fee. Deferral: fees held as credit.
items.withdraw_after_start: Before completing 6 months of principal course, withdrawing after census date: no refund for study periods starting in first 6 months (later prepaid periods refunded). After 6 months: before study period starts full refund of prepaid tuition; between start and census date 1 unit fee + $500 retained; after census date no refund for that period.
items.non_refundable: Application/enrolment fee; CoE processing fee; suspension fee; late payment fee; RPL fee; ancillary charges incl. card surcharges; graduation fees; library fines; re-mark fees; replacement ID; international postage; photocopying credits. OSHC refunded in full if visa refused or withdraw before commencement.
items.provider_default: Full refund of prepaid course/tuition fees if course cannot be offered/completed, within 14 days of default day, or alternative course at no additional cost; TPS support.
items.document: Refund Policy (PHE006) - covers APIC, HELI and ECA College of Health Sciences - Version 1.1, effective 20 July 2026
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: refund of all fees minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less); proof of refusal required; apply within 6 months. Withdrawal ≥4 weeks before start: deduction of 1 unit's fee + AUD 500; <4 weeks: 2 units + AUD 500; generally no refund for the current period after start; application/enrolment fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); ต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธ; ยื่นขอภายใน 6 เดือน ถอนตัว ≥4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: หักค่าเรียน 1 unit + AUD 500; <4 สัปดาห์: 2 unit + AUD 500; โดยทั่วไปไม่คืนเงินของช่วงเวลาปัจจุบันหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร/ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn); cần có bằng chứng bị từ chối; nộp yêu cầu trong vòng 6 tháng. Rút học ≥4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: khấu trừ phí của 1 học phần (unit) + AUD 500; <4 tuần: 2 học phần + AUD 500; thông thường không hoàn tiền cho kỳ hiện tại sau khi khai giảng; phí nộp hồ sơ/ghi danh không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还全部费用，扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）；需提供拒签证明；须在 6 个月内申请。开课前 ≥4 周退学：扣除 1 个单元的费用 + AUD 500；<4 周：2 个单元 + AUD 500；开课后当期费用一般不予退还；申请/注册费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：全費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金。却下の証明が必要で、6か月以内に申請する必要があります。開始の4週間以上前の取り下げ：1ユニット分の費用＋AUD 500を差し引き。4週間未満：2ユニット分＋AUD 500。開始後は原則として当該期間の返金はありません。出願料/入学金は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 모든 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, 거절 증빙이 필요하고 6개월 이내에 신청해야 합니다. 개강 4주 이상 전 철회 시: 1개 유닛 비용 + AUD 500 공제, 4주 미만: 2개 유닛 비용 + AUD 500 공제, 개강 후에는 일반적으로 현재 기간에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비/입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញនូវថ្លៃទាំងអស់ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ត្រូវមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធ; ត្រូវដាក់ពាក្យក្នុងរយៈពេល 6 ខែ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ កាត់ថ្លៃ 1 unit + AUD 500; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 2 units + AUD 500; ជាទូទៅមិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់រយៈពេលបច្ចុប្បន្នក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ/ចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Leaders Institute Pty Ltd (brands: Leaders Institute, Australian Business Institute, Australian Agribusiness Institute)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund 100% tuition yang sudah dibayar dengan bukti surat penolakan visa. Batal kurang dari 28 hari sebelum mulai: deposit AUD 2.000 tidak dikembalikan; setelah mulai, refund penuh hanya jika mundur sebelum census date unit, setelah census date tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: 100% of tuition fees paid, within 28 days of the census date of the affected units. Written notification plus documents showing the refusal (e.g. original letter from Australian Embassy, High Commission or Immigration Office). Deductions not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Cancellation less than 28 days before commencement: non-refundable $2,000 deposit component applies. Deferral: $2,000 deposit component non-refundable. Cancellation 28 days or more before commencement: not stated.
items.withdraw_after_start: Leave/withdrawal on or before unit census date: 100% refund of unit tuition within 28 days of census date. After census date: no tuition refund unless exceptional, compelling or compassionate circumstances evidenced.
items.non_refundable: $2,000 international deposit component (deferral or cancellation <28 days before commencement). Other non-refundable fees per a Refund Schedule not reproduced in the policy. Unexpired OSHC may be refunded in limited cases.
items.provider_default: not stated in Refund Policy (policy lists student-default cases: no refund for fraudulent documents, misconduct cancellation, not requesting refund within 90 days of semester end, CoE cancelled for non-commencement/attendance/progress, withdrawal after census without evidence).
items.document: Refund Policy - Version 3.0, approved 13 February 2024
items.summary_en: Visa refused: 100% refund of tuition paid, with the visa refusal letter as proof. Cancellation less than 28 days before start: the AUD 2,000 deposit is not refunded; after start, full refund only if you withdraw before the unit census date; no refund after the census date. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนที่ชำระแล้ว 100% โดยใช้จดหมายปฏิเสธวีซ่าเป็นหลักฐาน ยกเลิกน้อยกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงินมัดจำ AUD 2,000; หลังเริ่มเรียน คืนเต็มจำนวนเฉพาะกรณีถอนตัวก่อน census date ของ unit นั้น; ไม่คืนเงินหลัง census date ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn 100% học phí đã đóng, với thư từ chối visa làm bằng chứng. Hủy dưới 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: khoản đặt cọc AUD 2,000 không được hoàn; sau khi khai giảng, chỉ hoàn toàn bộ nếu bạn rút trước census date của học phần; không hoàn tiền sau census date. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：凭拒签信退还 100% 已付学费。开课前不足 28 天取消：AUD 2,000 订金不予退还；开课后，仅在单元 census date 之前退学才可全额退款；census date 之后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：ビザ却下通知書を証明として、支払った授業料を100%返金。開始の28日前未満のキャンセル：AUD 2,000のデポジットは返金されません。開始後は、ユニットの census date より前に取り下げた場合のみ全額返金。census date 以降の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자 거절 시: 비자 거절 서신을 증빙으로 제출하면 납부한 수업료를 100% 환불합니다. 개강 28일 미만 전 취소 시: AUD 2,000 보증금(deposit)은 환불되지 않습니다. 개강 후에는 유닛 census date 이전에 철회하는 경우에만 전액 환불되며, census date 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ៖ សងវិញ 100% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលបានបង់ ដោយមានលិខិតបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការជាភស្តុតាង។ ការលុបចោលតិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ប្រាក់កក់ AUD 2,000 មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន សងវិញទាំងស្រុងតែក្នុងករណីអ្នកដកខ្លួនមុនថ្ងៃ census date របស់ unit ប៉ុណ្ណោះ; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយថ្ងៃ census date ទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund penuh biaya kursus dan materi dengan bukti penolakan visa. Mundur dalam 7 hari setelah bayar: refund dipotong biaya aplikasi AUD 250; setelah mulai: refund pro-rata minggu yang belum dipakai dikurangi AUD 250 dan biaya bank; biaya enrolment/OSHC/materi tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Full refund of course fees plus any materials fees paid, with authenticated proof of visa refusal attached to a completed Refund Application Form. No time limit stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Cooling-off: written notice within 7 days of paying fees = course fees refunded less AUD 250 application fee. No other pre-start notice thresholds stated.
items.withdraw_after_start: Written notice on/after commencement: unused course fees refunded pro rata by week, less AUD 250 application fee, bank charges and currency exchange fees. No refund of current study period fees if student breaches visa conditions or ABCI suspends/cancels enrolment.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee; non-tuition fees such as OSHC, enrolment and materials fees (except in visa refusal case); any fee not listed in the refund breakdown.
items.provider_default: Full refund of course and materials fees or alternative course at no extra cost (student's choice), within 14 business days of course ceasing; no form needed; otherwise Tuition Protection Service.
items.document: ABCI Fee payment and refund policy (Australian Business and Culinary Institute, RTO 45461, CRICOS 03742D) - Version 4.1, revised October 2023
items.summary_en: Visa refused: full refund of course and material fees with proof of visa refusal. Withdrawal within 7 days of payment: refund minus the AUD 250 application fee; after start: pro-rata refund for unused weeks minus AUD 250 and bank fees; enrolment/OSHC/material fees are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนค่าหลักสูตรและค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียนเต็มจำนวนเมื่อมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัวภายใน 7 วันหลังชำระเงิน: คืนเงินหักค่าสมัคร AUD 250; หลังเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินตามสัดส่วนสำหรับสัปดาห์ที่ยังไม่ได้เรียน หัก AUD 250 และค่าธรรมเนียมธนาคาร; ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน/OSHC/ค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn toàn bộ học phí khóa học và phí tài liệu khi có bằng chứng bị từ chối visa. Rút học trong vòng 7 ngày kể từ khi thanh toán: hoàn tiền trừ phí nộp hồ sơ AUD 250; sau khi khai giảng: hoàn theo tỷ lệ cho số tuần chưa học, trừ AUD 250 và phí ngân hàng; phí ghi danh/OSHC/tài liệu không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：凭拒签证明全额退还课程费和教材费。付款后 7 天内退学：退款扣除 AUD 250 申请费；开课后：按比例退还未使用周数的费用，扣除 AUD 250 和银行手续费；注册费/OSHC/教材费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：ビザ却下の証明があれば、コース費用と教材費を全額返金。支払いから7日以内の取り下げ：AUD 250の出願料を差し引いて返金。開始後：未使用週分を按分して、AUD 250と銀行手数料を差し引いて返金。入学金/OSHC/教材費は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자 거절 시: 비자 거절 증빙을 제출하면 코스 비용과 교재비가 전액 환불됩니다. 납부 후 7일 이내 철회 시: AUD 250 지원비를 공제하고 환불, 개강 후: 미사용 주(week)에 대해 일할 계산하여 AUD 250과 은행 수수료를 공제하고 환불합니다. 입학금/OSHC/교재비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុងនូវថ្លៃវគ្គសិក្សា និងថ្លៃសម្ភារៈ ដោយមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួនក្នុងរយៈពេល 7 ថ្ងៃបន្ទាប់ពីបង់ប្រាក់៖ សងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ AUD 250; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញតាមសមាមាត្រសម្រាប់សប្តាហ៍ដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើ ដកចេញ AUD 250 និងថ្លៃធនាគារ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន/OSHC/សម្ភារៈ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Leaders Institute Pty Ltd (brands: Leaders Institute, Australian Business Institute, Australian Agribusiness Institute)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund 100% tuition yang sudah dibayar dengan bukti surat penolakan visa. Batal kurang dari 28 hari sebelum mulai: deposit AUD 2.000 tidak dikembalikan; setelah mulai, refund penuh hanya jika mundur sebelum census date unit, setelah census date tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: 100% of tuition fees paid, within 28 days of the census date of the affected units. Written notification plus documents showing the refusal (e.g. original letter from Australian Embassy, High Commission or Immigration Office). Deductions not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Cancellation less than 28 days before commencement: non-refundable $2,000 deposit component applies. Deferral: $2,000 deposit component non-refundable. Cancellation 28 days or more before commencement: not stated.
items.withdraw_after_start: Leave/withdrawal on or before unit census date: 100% refund of unit tuition within 28 days of census date. After census date: no tuition refund unless exceptional, compelling or compassionate circumstances evidenced.
items.non_refundable: $2,000 international deposit component (deferral or cancellation <28 days before commencement). Other non-refundable fees per a Refund Schedule not reproduced in the policy. Unexpired OSHC may be refunded in limited cases.
items.provider_default: not stated in Refund Policy (policy lists student-default cases: no refund for fraudulent documents, misconduct cancellation, not requesting refund within 90 days of semester end, CoE cancelled for non-commencement/attendance/progress, withdrawal after census without evidence).
items.document: Refund Policy - Version 3.0, approved 13 February 2024
items.summary_en: Visa refused: 100% refund of tuition paid, with the visa refusal letter as proof. Cancellation less than 28 days before start: the AUD 2,000 deposit is not refunded; after start, full refund only if you withdraw before the unit census date; no refund after the census date. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนที่ชำระแล้ว 100% โดยใช้จดหมายปฏิเสธวีซ่าเป็นหลักฐาน ยกเลิกน้อยกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงินมัดจำ AUD 2,000; หลังเริ่มเรียน คืนเต็มจำนวนเฉพาะกรณีถอนตัวก่อน census date ของ unit นั้น; ไม่คืนเงินหลัง census date ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn 100% học phí đã đóng, với thư từ chối visa làm bằng chứng. Hủy dưới 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: khoản đặt cọc AUD 2,000 không được hoàn; sau khi khai giảng, chỉ hoàn toàn bộ nếu bạn rút trước census date của học phần; không hoàn tiền sau census date. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：凭拒签信退还 100% 已付学费。开课前不足 28 天取消：AUD 2,000 订金不予退还；开课后，仅在单元 census date 之前退学才可全额退款；census date 之后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：ビザ却下通知書を証明として、支払った授業料を100%返金。開始の28日前未満のキャンセル：AUD 2,000のデポジットは返金されません。開始後は、ユニットの census date より前に取り下げた場合のみ全額返金。census date 以降の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, semua biaya dikembalikan (kecuali jika penolakan karena dokumen palsu/tidak lengkap: dipotong AUD 500 atau 5%, mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur 4 minggu atau lebih sebelum mulai dipotong 10% biaya satu semester, kurang dari 4 minggu dipotong 25%, setelah mulai sebelum census date dipotong 50%, setelah minggu ke-4 tidak ada refund; deposit non-refundable dan agency fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: If the Department of Home Affairs refuses the student visa, any fee paid by the student will be refunded (cl. 17). If refusal results from fraudulent, misleading or incomplete documents/information, ACU retains the lesser of AUD 500 or 5% of total prepaid course fees (cl. 18). Time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Amount retained (based on one semester/term full-time fees): change of mind within 48 hours of payment – 5%; 4 weeks or more before commencement – 10%; less than 4 weeks before commencement – 25%.
items.withdraw_after_start: On or after commencement and before census date – 50% retained. Withdrawal (or cancellation for non-payment) after the fourth teaching week of the study period – no tuition refund.
items.non_refundable: Deposits identified as non-refundable (even if offer deferred); agency fees; fees forfeited if offer withdrawn due to incorrect/incomplete information.
items.provider_default: Full refund if ACU withdraws the offer or cannot provide/stops providing the course; refund within two weeks of cancellation, or student may accept a substitute program. OSHC paid via ACU refunded.
items.document: Commencing International Student Refunds Policy - not stated (current version on ACU Policy Library)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, all fees are refunded (unless the refusal was due to false/incomplete documents: deduction of AUD 500 or 5%, whichever is less). Withdrawal 4 weeks or more before start: 10% of one semester's fees deducted; less than 4 weeks: 25% deducted; after start but before the census date: 50% deducted; no refund after week 4; the non-refundable deposit and agency fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมด (เว้นแต่การปฏิเสธเกิดจากเอกสารเท็จ/ไม่ครบถ้วน: หัก AUD 500 หรือ 5% แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัว 4 สัปดาห์ขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: หัก 10% ของค่าเรียนหนึ่งภาคการศึกษา; น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์: หัก 25%; หลังเริ่มเรียนแต่ก่อน census date: หัก 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังสัปดาห์ที่ 4; ไม่คืนเงินมัดจำที่ไม่สามารถขอคืนได้และค่าธรรมเนียมเอเจนซี่ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, toàn bộ các khoản phí được hoàn (trừ khi bị từ chối do giấy tờ giả/không đầy đủ: khấu trừ AUD 500 hoặc 5%, tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học từ 4 tuần trở lên trước khi khai giảng: khấu trừ 10% học phí một học kỳ; dưới 4 tuần: khấu trừ 25%; sau khi khai giảng nhưng trước census date: khấu trừ 50%; không hoàn tiền sau tuần thứ 4; khoản đặt cọc không hoàn lại và phí đại lý không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，退还全部费用（如因虚假/不完整文件被拒：扣除 AUD 500 或 5%，以较低者为准）。开课前 4 周或以上退学：扣除一个学期费用的 10%；不足 4 周：扣除 25%；开课后但在 census date 之前：扣除 50%；第 4 周之后不予退款；不可退订金和中介费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、全費用が返金されます（虚偽/不完全な書類による却下の場合は、AUD 500または5%のいずれか少ない方を差し引き）。開始の4週間以上前の取り下げ：1セメスター分の費用の10%を差し引き。4週間未満：25%を差し引き。開始後、census date 前：50%を差し引き。第4週以降の返金はありません。返金不可のデポジットとエージェント手数料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우 모든 비용이 환불됩니다(허위/불완전한 서류로 인한 거절인 경우: AUD 500 또는 5% 중 적은 금액 공제). 개강 4주 이상 전 철회 시: 한 학기 비용의 10% 공제, 4주 미만: 25% 공제, 개강 후 census date 이전: 50% 공제, 4주차 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 환불 불가 보증금과 에이전시 수수료는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ (លើកលែងតែការបដិសេធនោះបណ្តាលមកពីឯកសារក្លែងក្លាយ/មិនពេញលេញ៖ កាត់ AUD 500 ឬ 5% យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួន 4 សប្តាហ៍ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ កាត់ 10% នៃថ្លៃមួយឆមាស; តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍៖ កាត់ 25%; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន ប៉ុន្តែមុនថ្ងៃ census date៖ កាត់ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយសប្តាហ៍ទី 4 ទេ; ប្រាក់កក់ដែលមិនអាចសងវិញបាន និងថ្លៃភ្នាក់ងារ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, tuition dikembalikan dikurangi A$250 dan material fee kembali 100%. Mundur ≥28 hari sebelum mulai: 70% tuition kembali; <28 hari: 50%; setelah mulai atau menunda: tidak ada refund semester berjalan. Application fee A$200 tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Refund of tuition fee less A$250 admin processing fee; 100% refund of material fee. Evidence/time limit: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written withdrawal received 28 days or more before commencement: 70% tuition refund + 100% material fee refund. Less than 28 days before commencement (but before start date): 50% tuition refund + 100% material fee refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: Withdrawal on/after commencement date, or deferment by the student: no refund of current semester tuition or material fee.
items.non_refundable: Application fee A$200; RPL fee A$250; optional homestay assistant fee A$250 and airport meeting A$150; any fee not listed in the refund section (e.g. CoE re-issue A$100, repeat unit A$500, re-sit A$100, late payment A$200).
items.provider_default: If ACIS cannot deliver the course in full: refund of all course money paid to date within 2 weeks of the day the course stopped, or a place in another course at no extra cost (student chooses); otherwise TPS assists.
items.document: ACIS Student Application Form (VET) incl. Written Agreement - Part D Refund - Written Agreement Version 3.0, April 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, tuition is refunded minus A$250 and material fees are refunded 100%. Withdrawal ≥28 days before start: 70% of tuition refunded; <28 days: 50%; after start or deferral: no refund for the current semester. The A$200 application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนหัก A$250 และคืนค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน 100% ถอนตัว ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 70%; <28 วัน: 50%; หลังเริ่มเรียนหรือเลื่อนการเรียน: ไม่คืนเงินของภาคการศึกษาปัจจุบัน ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร A$200 ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, học phí được hoàn sau khi trừ A$250 và phí tài liệu được hoàn 100%. Rút học ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70% học phí; <28 ngày: 50%; sau khi khai giảng hoặc hoãn học: không hoàn tiền cho học kỳ hiện tại. Phí nộp hồ sơ A$200 không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，退还学费并扣除 A$250，教材费 100% 退还。开课前 ≥28 天退学：退还 70% 学费；<28 天：50%；开课后或延期：当前学期不予退款。A$200 申请费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、授業料はA$250を差し引いて返金され、教材費は100%返金されます。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：授業料の70%を返金。28日未満：50%。開始後または延期の場合：当該セメスターの返金はありません。A$200の出願料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 수업료는 A$250를 공제한 후 환불되며 교재비는 100% 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료의 70% 환불, 28일 미만: 50%, 개강 후 또는 연기(deferral) 시: 현재 학기에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. A$200 지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ A$250 ហើយថ្លៃសម្ភារៈត្រូវបានសងវិញ 100%។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 70%; <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន ឬការពន្យារពេល៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់ឆមាសបច្ចុប្បន្នទេ។ ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ A$200 មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, refund dihitung sesuai ketentuan ESOS (sebagai special circumstance: seluruh biaya kembali dikurangi registration fee, student kit dan fee agen) dengan bukti pendukung. Mundur ≥28 hari sebelum mulai: 100% tuition kembali; <28 hari: 50%; tidak datang atau setelah mulai: tidak ada refund. Registration fee, student kit, biaya administrasi dan fee agen tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: If visa refused and student does not start or withdraws after commencing: refund (if any) calculated under the ESOS (Calculation of Refund) Specification 2014; relevant supporting evidence required; paid within 4 weeks of claim. 'Visa not granted' is also a special circumstance: all course fees paid refunded less registration fee, student kit and agent fees. Exact amounts: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written cancellation 28 days or more before commencement: 100% of tuition fees paid in advance. Less than 28 days before: 50% of tuition paid. Failure to commence (with or without notice): no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund after commencement (student liable for unpaid fees), except special circumstances (serious illness with medical certificate, family tragedy, acts of God/government, visa not granted): all course fees paid less registration fee, student kit and agent fees.
items.non_refundable: Registration fee, student kit fee, administration fees and fees paid to education agents (amounts not stated). Website lists course withdrawal fee AUD 200 (refundability not stated).
items.provider_default: Refund of all course money paid to date within 2 weeks of the day the course ceased, or a place in another course at no extra cost (student chooses and signs acceptance).
items.document: ACPC Student Refund Policy - Version 2.1, February 2022
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, the refund is calculated under ESOS rules (as a special circumstance: all fees refunded minus the registration fee, student kit and agent fee) with supporting evidence. Withdrawal ≥28 days before start: 100% of tuition refunded; <28 days: 50%; no-show or after start: no refund. Registration fee, student kit, administration fee and agent fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ การคืนเงินจะคำนวณตามกฎ ESOS (ถือเป็นกรณีพิเศษ: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักค่าลงทะเบียน (registration fee) ชุดอุปกรณ์นักเรียน (student kit) และค่าธรรมเนียมเอเจนต์) โดยต้องมีหลักฐานประกอบ ถอนตัว ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 100%; <28 วัน: 50%; ไม่มาเรียนหรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียน ชุดอุปกรณ์นักเรียน ค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ และค่าธรรมเนียมเอเจนต์ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, khoản hoàn được tính theo quy định ESOS (như một trường hợp đặc biệt: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ phí đăng ký, bộ dụng cụ học tập và phí đại lý) kèm bằng chứng. Rút học ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100% học phí; <28 ngày: 50%; không đến nhập học hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền. Phí đăng ký, bộ dụng cụ học tập, phí hành chính và phí đại lý không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，退款按 ESOS 规定计算（作为特殊情况：退还全部费用，扣除注册费、学生用品包和中介费），需提供证明材料。开课前 ≥28 天退学：退还 100% 学费；<28 天：50%；未报到或开课后：不予退款。注册费、学生用品包、行政费和中介费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、裏付け書類に基づき、返金額はESOSの規定に従って算出されます（特別な事情として：登録料、スチューデントキット、エージェント手数料を差し引いて全費用を返金）。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：授業料の100%を返金。28日未満：50%。不出席または開始後：返金なし。登録料、スチューデントキット、事務手数料、エージェント手数料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 증빙 자료를 제출하면 ESOS 규정에 따라 환불액이 계산됩니다(특별 사유로서: 등록비, 학생 키트, 에이전트 수수료를 공제한 모든 비용 환불). 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료 100% 환불, 28일 미만: 50%, 미출석(no-show) 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 등록비, 학생 키트, 행정비, 에이전트 수수료는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ការសងប្រាក់វិញត្រូវបានគណនាតាមច្បាប់ ESOS (ជាករណីពិសេស៖ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះ កញ្ចប់សម្ភារៈសិស្ស និងថ្លៃភ្នាក់ងារ) ដោយមានភស្តុតាងគាំទ្រ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 100%; <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%; មិនមកចូលរៀន ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះ កញ្ចប់សម្ភារៈសិស្ស ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល និងថ្លៃភ្នាក់ងារ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai (dengan surat resmi Home Affairs), tuition dikembalikan dikurangi application fee AUD 350 dan admin fee AUD 150. Mundur lebih dari 28 hari sebelum mulai refund 60% tuition, kurang dari 28 hari refund 30%; setelah kursus mulai tidak ada refund; application fee dan non-tuition fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before course/semester starts: full refund of prepaid tuition less AUD 350 application fee and AUD 150 admin fee. After course/semester starts: full refund of prepaid tuition less AUD 250 cancellation admin fee and pro-rata (weekly) tuition used. Evidence: written advice from the Department of Home Affairs. Paid within 28 days of ADCI receiving that advice.
items.withdraw_before_start: (Student visa holders) More than 28 days before course start: 60% of prepaid tuition refunded (40% of semester tuition retained as cancellation fee). Less than 28 days before: 30% refunded (70% retained).
items.withdraw_after_start: On or after commencement: no refund (100% of semester tuition retained). Withdrawing during a semester and more than 28 days before next semester: no refund for current semester, at least 60% of next semester's fees and full refund of later semester fees, less cancellation fees.
items.non_refundable: Non-tuition fees including the Application Fee. No refund for enrolment cancelled for visa breach, false statement, fraudulent documents, misconduct or non-payment.
items.provider_default: If ADCI cannot offer a unit/course: within 14 days refund the unused prepaid tuition or offer alternative placement (accepted in writing); otherwise TPS. Full refund if offer withdrawn or course cannot be provided to a commencing student.
items.document: Student Withdrawal and Refund Policy – Australian Data and Cyber Institute (ADCI) - Version 3.1, approved 26.09.2024
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start (with an official Home Affairs letter), tuition is refunded minus the AUD 350 application fee and AUD 150 admin fee. Withdrawal more than 28 days before start: 60% tuition refund; less than 28 days: 30%; no refund after the course starts; application fee and non-tuition fees are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน (มีจดหมายทางการจาก Home Affairs) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักค่าสมัคร AUD 350 และค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 150 ถอนตัวมากกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 60%; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: 30%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร; ไม่คืนค่าสมัครและค่าใช้จ่ายที่ไม่ใช่ค่าเล่าเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng (có thư chính thức của Home Affairs), học phí được hoàn sau khi trừ phí nộp hồ sơ AUD 350 và phí hành chính AUD 150. Rút học hơn 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 60% học phí; dưới 28 ngày: 30%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khóa học bắt đầu; phí nộp hồ sơ và các khoản phí ngoài học phí không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒（需提供 Home Affairs 正式信函），退还学费并扣除 AUD 350 申请费和 AUD 150 行政费。开课前超过 28 天退学：退还 60% 学费；不足 28 天：30%；课程开始后不予退款；申请费和非学费费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合（Home Affairsの公式通知書が必要）、授業料からAUD 350の出願料とAUD 150の事務手数料を差し引いて返金されます。開始の28日超前の取り下げ：授業料の60%を返金。28日未満：30%。コース開始後の返金はありません。出願料と授業料以外の費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우(Home Affairs 공식 서신 제출 시), 수업료에서 AUD 350 지원비와 AUD 150 행정비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료 60% 환불, 28일 미만: 30%, 코스 시작 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비와 수업료 외 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន (មានលិខិតផ្លូវការពី Home Affairs) ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ AUD 350 និងថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 150។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 60%; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 30%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើមទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ និងថ្លៃមិនមែនថ្លៃសិក្សា មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Australian Global Institute (AGI), RTO 31690
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund minimal 95% (potongan 5% maksimal AUD 500). Mundur >4 minggu sebelum mulai refund 80% tuition, 0–4 minggu pro-rata sesuai ESOS, setelah mulai tidak ada refund; application fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course commencement: at least 95% refunded; AGI fee 5% of total fees capped at $500. Refusal after commencement not stated. Evidence/time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 4 weeks before commencement: 80% of tuition fees paid refunded (20% retained). 0–4 weeks before commencement: 'pro-rata basis under the ESOS Act 2000' (the page shows an unfilled '$X00 max.' placeholder for the fee).
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund (100% retained). Failure to commence without notice: no refund.
items.non_refundable: Application fees; AGI may deduct non-tuition fees or third-party charges already incurred.
items.provider_default: Full refund of unspent tuition fees; AGI meets ESOS/TPS obligations, notifies students in writing within 14 days and offers alternative course at no extra cost where possible or refund.
items.document: Policies - International Students (refund section) - not stated (web page; last modified 27 May 2026 per page metadata)
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: refund of at least 95% (5% deduction, max. AUD 500). Withdrawal >4 weeks before start: 80% tuition refund; 0–4 weeks: pro-rata under ESOS; no refund after start; the application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินอย่างน้อย 95% (หัก 5% สูงสุด AUD 500) ถอนตัว >4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 80%; 0–4 สัปดาห์: คืนตามสัดส่วนภายใต้ ESOS; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn ít nhất 95% (khấu trừ 5%, tối đa AUD 500). Rút học >4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 80% học phí; 0–4 tuần: hoàn theo tỷ lệ theo ESOS; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí nộp hồ sơ không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：至少退还 95%（扣除 5%，最高 AUD 500）。开课前 >4 周退学：退还 80% 学费；0–4 周：按 ESOS 按比例退还；开课后不予退款；申请费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：少なくとも95%を返金（5%差し引き、上限AUD 500）。開始の4週間超前の取り下げ：授業料の80%を返金。0〜4週間前：ESOSに基づき按分。開始後の返金はありません。出願料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 최소 95% 환불(5% 공제, 최대 AUD 500). 개강 4주 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료 80% 환불, 0–4주: ESOS에 따라 일할 계산, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញយ៉ាងហោចណាស់ 95% (កាត់ 5% អតិបរមា AUD 500)។ ការដកខ្លួន >4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 80%; 0–4 សប្តាហ៍៖ តាមសមាមាត្រក្រោម ESOS; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak (bukan karena kesalahan siswa), tuition fee yang belum terpakai dikembalikan dikurangi AUD 500 atau 5% (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur 28 hari atau lebih sebelum mulai refund 50%, kurang dari 28 hari refund 30% (dipotong admin AUD 500); setelah kursus mulai tidak ada refund; enrolment fee AUD 200 dan material fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused not caused by the student (withdrawal received before or after commencement): 100% refund of UNUSED paid tuition fee, less the lesser of AUD 500 or 5% of tuition fee paid (before commencement) / AUD 500 (other cases). Visa refused due to the student (e.g. forged documents, not providing DHA-required documents): no refund of any paid fee. Withdrawal must be in writing with supporting documents.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written withdrawal 28 days or more before commencement: 50% refund of paid tuition fee. Less than 28 days before commencement: 30% refund of tuition fee paid. AUD 500 administration fee deducted.
items.withdraw_after_start: Withdrawal on or after the original course commencement date: no refund of any paid fee. Termination for breach/visa breach/misconduct: no refund.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment/application fees (AUD 200 enrolment fee), CoE revision charges, material fees, administration service fees, accommodation and guardian placement fees, airport transfer fees and other non-refundable charges (e.g. AUD 100 eCoE reissue, AUD 250 credit transfer/RPL application fee).
items.provider_default: If AIC cannot deliver the course it offers an alternative placement; if the student does not accept it, full refund of unexpended (unused prepaid) tuition fees within 14 days of the course ceasing. TPS assists with placement.
items.document: Student Agreement (General Terms and Conditions of Enrolment) – Australian Ideal College - not stated
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused (not due to the student's fault), unused tuition fees are refunded minus AUD 500 or 5% (whichever is less). Withdrawal 28 days or more before start: 50% refund; less than 28 days: 30% refund (minus AUD 500 admin); no refund after the course starts; the AUD 200 enrolment fee and material fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ (ไม่ใช่ความผิดของนักเรียน) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ใช้หักออก AUD 500 หรือ 5% (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัว 28 วันขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 50%; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: คืน 30% (หักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 500); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร; ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 200 และค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối (không do lỗi của sinh viên), học phí chưa sử dụng được hoàn sau khi trừ AUD 500 hoặc 5% (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học từ 28 ngày trở lên trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 50%; dưới 28 ngày: hoàn 30% (trừ phí hành chính AUD 500); không hoàn tiền sau khi khóa học bắt đầu; phí ghi danh AUD 200 và phí tài liệu không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒（非学生过错所致），退还未使用的学费，扣除 AUD 500 或 5%（以较低者为准）。开课前 28 天或以上退学：退还 50%；不足 28 天：退还 30%（扣除 AUD 500 行政费）；课程开始后不予退款；AUD 200 注册费和教材费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合（学生の責任によらない場合）、未使用の授業料からAUD 500または5%（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：50%返金。28日未満：30%返金（AUD 500の事務手数料を差し引き）。コース開始後の返金はありません。AUD 200の入学金と教材費は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우(학생의 귀책 사유가 아닌 경우), 미사용 수업료에서 AUD 500 또는 5%(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 50% 환불, 28일 미만: 30% 환불(AUD 500 행정비 공제), 코스 시작 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. AUD 200 입학금과 교재비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ (មិនមែនដោយកំហុសរបស់សិស្ស) ថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ AUD 500 ឬ 5% (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួន 28 ថ្ងៃ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 50%; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ សងវិញ 30% (ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 500); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើមទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 200 និងថ្លៃសម្ភារៈ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។
