items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, refund dihitung dengan rumus 5% atau $500 sesuai dokumen (enrolment fee tidak dikembalikan) dan wajib ada surat penolakan visa, diajukan dalam 10 hari kerja. Mundur kurang dari 28 hari sebelum mulai tidak ada refund; setelah mulai hanya periode setelah pemberitahuan mundur yang dihitung. Enrolment/registration fee dan biaya RPL umumnya tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before commencement: document states '5% of tuition fees received before the default day, or $500' (statutory formula); enrolment/registration fee not refunded. After commencement: weekly tuition fee x weeks remaining in the paid period from the date of visa refusal. Visa refusal letter required. Claim within 10 business days of the event.
items.withdraw_before_start: At least 60 days before commencement (wording ambiguous): '5% of tuition fees received before the default day, or $500'; non-tuition fees not refunded. Less than 28 days before commencement: no refund of tuition or non-tuition fees. 28-60 days: not stated.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund for the period from commencement to the default day (date written withdrawal received); fees for the period after the default day refunded via refund calculator (weekly fee x weeks in default period).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment/registration fee (amount not stated; refundable only if visa refused before commencement or AIDT defaults - note visa section says it is not refunded); RPL application fee once assessment starts; late payment fee $50 per invoice.
items.provider_default: Before commencement: full refund of all tuition and non-tuition fees within 4 weeks; after commencement: unused portion via refund calculator; TPS manages placement or refund.
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy and Procedure (AIDT-POL-008) - Version 2.0, effective 1 June 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, the refund is calculated using the 5% or $500 formula per the document (enrolment fee not refunded); a visa refusal letter is required, submitted within 10 working days. Withdrawal less than 28 days before start: no refund; after start, only the period after the withdrawal notice is counted. Enrolment/registration fees and RPL fees are generally not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน การคืนเงินจะคำนวณด้วยสูตร 5% หรือ $500 ตามเอกสาร (ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน); ต้องใช้จดหมายปฏิเสธวีซ่า โดยยื่นภายใน 10 วันทำการ ถอนตัวน้อยกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน; หลังเริ่มเรียน นับเฉพาะช่วงเวลาหลังแจ้งถอนตัว โดยทั่วไปไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน/ค่าลงทะเบียน (registration fee) และค่า RPL ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, khoản hoàn được tính theo công thức 5% hoặc $500 như trong tài liệu (phí ghi danh không được hoàn); cần có thư từ chối visa, nộp trong vòng 10 ngày làm việc. Rút học dưới 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền; sau khi khai giảng, chỉ tính phần thời gian sau thông báo rút học. Phí ghi danh/đăng ký và phí RPL thông thường không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，按文件规定的 5% 或 $500 公式计算退款（注册费不予退还）；需在 10 个工作日内提交拒签信。开课前不足 28 天退学：不予退款；开课后，仅计算退学通知之后的期间。注册/报名费和 RPL 费用一般不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、返金額は書類に記載の5%または$500の計算式で算出されます（入学金は返金されません）。ビザ却下通知書が必要で、10営業日以内に提出する必要があります。開始の28日前未満の取り下げ：返金なし。開始後は、取り下げ通知以降の期間のみが対象となります。入学金/登録料およびRPL費用は原則として返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 문서에 따라 5% 또는 $500 공식으로 환불액이 계산되며(입학금은 환불되지 않음), 비자 거절 서신을 영업일 기준 10일 이내에 제출해야 합니다. 개강 28일 미만 전 철회 시: 환불되지 않으며, 개강 후에는 철회 통지 이후 기간만 계산됩니다. 입학금/등록비와 RPL 비용은 일반적으로 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ការសងប្រាក់វិញត្រូវបានគណនាដោយប្រើរូបមន្ត 5% ឬ $500 តាមឯកសារ (ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ); ត្រូវមានលិខិតបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ ដែលដាក់ជូនក្នុងរយៈពេល 10 ថ្ងៃធ្វើការ។ ការដកខ្លួនតិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន មានតែរយៈពេលក្រោយការជូនដំណឹងអំពីការដកខ្លួនប៉ុណ្ណោះដែលត្រូវបានគិត។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន/ថ្លៃចុះបញ្ជី និងថ្លៃ RPL ជាទូទៅមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak (belum mulai), tuition yang dibayar dikembalikan dikurangi biaya admin AUD 500. Mundur setelah CoE terbit: ≥28 hari sebelum mulai dipotong 50% tuition 4 unit pertama, <28 hari dipotong 75%; setelah mulai tidak ada refund (kecuali sudah menyelesaikan minimal 4 unit). Biaya enrolment, OSHC, akomodasi, dan airport transfer bisa tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused (student yet to commence): tuition fees paid refunded less AUD 500 administration fee. No refund if visa refused due to fraudulent documents. Time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Withdrew before CoE issued (after paying deposit): tuition paid less AUD 500. After CoE issued: 28 days or more before commencement - refund of tuition paid less 50% of tuition for the first 4 units; less than 28 days before commencement - tuition paid less 75% of tuition for the first 4 units. Withdrawal of visa application for compassionate/compelling reasons (AIH discretion): tuition paid less AUD 500.
items.withdraw_after_start: On or after commencement: no refund. Course withdrawal with fewer than 4 units completed: no refund. With 4+ units completed: 28 days or more before next compulsory block - 100% of unused tuition; less than 28 days - unused tuition less the fee for 1 unit. Single unit withdrawn before unit start: 100% credited to future units; on/after unit start: no refund or credit.
items.non_refundable: Some non-tuition fees, including enrolment fee, late payment fees, airport transfers, accommodation services and OSHC; AUD 500 administration fee where applied. No refund for breach of visa conditions/ESOS Act/enrolment terms (including non-commencement), fraudulent documents, misconduct cancellation, or requests after termination for non-payment.
items.provider_default: Refund of unspent tuition within 14 days of course ceasing, or a place in another course at no extra cost (student chooses). If AIH cannot do either, Tuition Protection Service (TPS) assists.
items.document: Refund Policy and Procedure for International and Domestic Students (ADM-HE-12) - Australian Institute of Higher Education Pty Ltd, CRICOS 03147A - Version 2024.1, approved 30 July 2024, commenced 31 July 2024
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused (before start), tuition paid is refunded minus an AUD 500 admin fee. Withdrawal after the CoE is issued: ≥28 days before start, 50% of tuition for the first 4 units deducted; <28 days, 75% deducted; no refund after start (unless at least 4 units have been completed). Enrolment, OSHC, accommodation and airport transfer fees may not be refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ (ก่อนเริ่มเรียน) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนที่ชำระแล้วหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 500 ถอนตัวหลังได้รับ CoE: ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน หัก 50% ของค่าเล่าเรียน 4 unit แรก; <28 วัน หัก 75%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน (เว้นแต่เรียนจบอย่างน้อย 4 unit แล้ว) ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน OSHC ค่าที่พัก และค่ารับส่งสนามบินอาจไม่ได้รับคืน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối (trước khi khai giảng), học phí đã đóng được hoàn sau khi trừ phí hành chính AUD 500. Rút học sau khi CoE đã được cấp: ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng, khấu trừ 50% học phí của 4 học phần đầu tiên; <28 ngày, khấu trừ 75%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng (trừ khi đã hoàn thành ít nhất 4 học phần). Phí ghi danh, OSHC, chỗ ở và đưa đón sân bay có thể không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒（开课前），退还已付学费并扣除 AUD 500 行政费。CoE 签发后退学：开课前 ≥28 天，扣除前 4 个单元学费的 50%；<28 天，扣除 75%；开课后不予退款（除非已完成至少 4 个单元）。注册费、OSHC、住宿费和接送机费用可能不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合（開始前）、支払った授業料からAUD 500の事務手数料を差し引いて返金されます。CoE発行後の取り下げ：開始の28日以上前は最初の4ユニット分の授業料の50%を差し引き、28日未満は75%を差し引き。開始後の返金はありません（少なくとも4ユニットを修了している場合を除く）。入学金、OSHC、宿泊費、空港送迎費は返金されない場合があります。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우(개강 전), 납부한 수업료에서 AUD 500 행정비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. CoE 발급 후 철회 시: 개강 28일 이상 전에는 첫 4개 유닛 수업료의 50% 공제, 28일 미만에는 75% 공제, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다(최소 4개 유닛을 이수한 경우 제외). 입학금, OSHC, 숙소비, 공항 이동 비용은 환불되지 않을 수 있습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ (មុនពេលចូលរៀន) ថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលបានបង់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 500។ ការដកខ្លួនក្រោយពេល CoE ត្រូវបានចេញ៖ ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន កាត់ 50% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាសម្រាប់ 4 units ដំបូង; <28 ថ្ងៃ កាត់ 75%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ (លើកលែងតែបានបញ្ចប់យ៉ាងហោចណាស់ 4 units)។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន OSHC កន្លែងស្នាក់នៅ និងថ្លៃដឹកជញ្ជូនពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ ប្រហែលជាមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Australian Hospitality Skills Recognition Pty Ltd (trading as Australian Skills Management Institute, ASMI)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum kursus dimulai, ASMI mengembalikan biaya kuliah (dapat dipotong biaya CoE $200 dan admin $100; dokumen tidak konsisten). Mundur sebelum mulai mendapat refund 70-75% bila visa belum disetujui, tetapi hanya 10% bila visa sudah disetujui; setelah kursus dimulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before course start (certified evidence, written request, Form F38): full refund of tuition, or (Table A) 100% refund less $200 CoE/application processing fee and $100 administration fee - the document is inconsistent on these deductions. No refund if refused because of fraudulent/bogus documents or wrong information.
items.withdraw_before_start: Without visa approval: 28+ days before commencement 75% refunded; less than 28 days 70% refunded. With visa approved (Table A): 10% refunded (ASMI retains 90%). Table B instead lists 75%/70% for notified withdrawal - document is inconsistent.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund on or after commencement; student may remain liable for full course tuition plus debt-recovery costs.
items.non_refundable: $200 application processing/CoE fee and $100 administration fee (visa refusal cases); all fees where visa refused for fraud/wrong information; fees after start for visa-approved withdrawals; fees where course terminated for serious breach.
items.provider_default: If ASMI cannot deliver the course: refund of tuition paid for uncompleted units within 2 weeks of training ceasing, or a place in a suitable alternative course (accepted in writing); otherwise TPS assists.
items.document: P03 - Refund Policy and Procedure - Version 4.1, approved 25 May 2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before the course starts, ASMI refunds tuition fees (a $200 CoE fee and $100 admin fee may be deducted; the documents are inconsistent). Withdrawal before start: 70-75% refund if the visa has not been approved, but only 10% if the visa has been approved; no refund after the course starts. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มหลักสูตร ASMI จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียน (อาจหักค่า CoE $200 และค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ $100; เอกสารระบุไม่ตรงกัน) ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 70-75% หากวีซ่ายังไม่ได้รับอนุมัติ แต่คืนเพียง 10% หากวีซ่าได้รับอนุมัติแล้ว; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khóa học bắt đầu, ASMI hoàn học phí (có thể trừ phí CoE $200 và phí hành chính $100; các tài liệu không thống nhất). Rút học trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70-75% nếu visa chưa được duyệt, nhưng chỉ 10% nếu visa đã được duyệt; không hoàn tiền sau khi khóa học bắt đầu. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如课程开始前签证被拒，ASMI 退还学费（可能扣除 $200 CoE 费和 $100 行政费；文件说法不一致）。开课前退学：如签证尚未获批，退还 70-75%；如签证已获批，仅退还 10%；课程开始后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: コース開始前にビザが却下された場合、ASMIは授業料を返金します（$200のCoE費用と$100の事務手数料が差し引かれる場合があります。書類間で記載に不一致があります）。開始前の取り下げ：ビザが承認されていない場合は70〜75%返金、ビザが承認済みの場合は10%のみ。コース開始後の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 코스 시작 전 비자가 거절된 경우, ASMI는 수업료를 환불합니다($200 CoE 비용과 $100 행정비가 공제될 수 있으며, 문서 간 내용이 일치하지 않습니다). 개강 전 철회 시: 비자가 승인되지 않은 경우 70-75% 환불, 비자가 승인된 경우 10%만 환불되며, 코스 시작 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើម ASMI សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ (អាចកាត់ថ្លៃ CoE $200 និងថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល $100; ឯកសារមិនស៊ីសង្វាក់គ្នា)។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 70-75% ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការមិនទាន់ត្រូវបានអនុម័ត ប៉ុន្តែត្រឹមតែ 10% ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានអនុម័តហើយ; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើមទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.visa_refused: Current Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy (POL 1.15) does not state amounts; it refers to the written agreement. Older International Student Handbook V2 (April 2021) states: visa refused before or after commencement – refund of fees received less the lower of 5% of total fees or AUD 500; no refund if visa refused due to the student's own actions. Policy lists visa refusal letter as supporting evidence.
items.withdraw_before_start: Not stated in current policy. Handbook V2 (April 2021): withdrawal up to 4 weeks before start – application fee kept, all other fees refunded; less than 4 weeks before start – application fee kept, 90% of other fees refunded; not starting on agreed date without prior withdrawal – no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: Not stated in current policy. Handbook V2 (April 2021): no refund; fees for the full study period (term) payable.
items.non_refundable: Policy: administration or enrolment fees if non-refundable (amounts not stated). Handbook V2 (April 2021): application fees non-refundable except where the college cancels the course; refund processing fee AUD 100.
items.provider_default: Not stated in current policy. Handbook V2 (April 2021): before commencement full refund of all fees; after commencement refund of unspent fees; paid within 10 working days, no form needed.
items.source_url: https://www.ausc.edu.au/policy/1.15 Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy and Procedure (2).pdf ; https://www.ausc.edu.au/handbook/AuSC-International-Student-Handbook-V2.pdf
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy and Procedure (POL 1.15); International Student Handbook - Policy: V1 July 2026 (inner pages; cover says V1.1 April 2021). Handbook: V2 April 2021

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund 100% biaya kuliah (wajib surat penolakan visa), tetapi semua refund dikenakan biaya admin AUD 500 dan biaya enrolment tidak dikembalikan. Mundur sebelum mulai: 50% (≥28 hari) atau 30% (<28 hari); setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Rejection letter received before commencement: 100% refund of tuition fee paid; after commencement: 100% of unused tuition fee (by course duration percentage). Official visa rejection letter required. Enrolment and holding fees non-refundable. Policy also states all refunds attract an AUD 500 administration charge.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice at least 28 days before commencement: 50% of tuition fee paid; less than 28 days: 30%. Enrolment/holding fees non-refundable.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee and holding fee (where applicable); no refund after commencement, for cancellation due to misconduct/policy breach, visa breach or failure to meet course requirements. AUD 500 administration charge on all refunds.
items.provider_default: Course not starting on agreed date / sanction / cancelled before start: 100% refund of tuition paid; cancelled after start: 100% of unused tuition; no compliant written agreement: full refund of unused tuition.
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refund Policy and Procedure (AWS Institute Pty Ltd t/a Australian Workplace Skills Institute, CRICOS 03924J, RTO 45701) - Version 2.0, last updated July 2025
items.summary_en: Visa refused: 100% tuition refund (visa refusal letter required), but all refunds incur an AUD 500 admin fee and the enrolment fee is not refunded. Withdrawal before start: 50% (≥28 days) or 30% (<28 days); no refund after start. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 100% (ต้องมีจดหมายปฏิเสธวีซ่า) แต่การคืนเงินทุกกรณีจะถูกหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 500 และไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: 50% (≥28 วัน) หรือ 30% (<28 วัน); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn 100% học phí (cần thư từ chối visa), nhưng mọi khoản hoàn đều bị tính phí hành chính AUD 500 và phí ghi danh không được hoàn. Rút học trước khi khai giảng: 50% (≥28 ngày) hoặc 30% (<28 ngày); không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：退还 100% 学费（需提供拒签信），但所有退款均收取 AUD 500 行政费，且注册费不予退还。开课前退学：50%（≥28 天）或 30%（<28 天）；开课后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：授業料を100%返金（ビザ却下通知書が必要）。ただし、すべての返金にAUD 500の事務手数料がかかり、入学金は返金されません。開始前の取り下げ：50%（28日以上前）または30%（28日未満）。開始後の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자 거절 시: 수업료 100% 환불(비자 거절 서신 필요). 단, 모든 환불에는 AUD 500 행정비가 부과되며 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 50%(28일 이상) 또는 30%(28일 미만), 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 100% (ត្រូវមានលិខិតបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ) ប៉ុន្តែការសងប្រាក់វិញទាំងអស់ត្រូវកាត់ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 500 ហើយថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 50% (≥28 ថ្ងៃ) ឬ 30% (<28 ថ្ងៃ); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak (asli, bukan dokumen palsu), tuition dikembalikan 100% kecuali enrolment fee, dengan bukti surat penolakan. Mundur ≥28 hari sebelum mulai: 80% tuition kembali; <28 hari: 50%; setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Enrolment fee, OSHC, materi dan komisi agen tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Genuine refusal: 100% of tuition fees paid refunded, enrolment fee not refunded; bank/transfer fees deducted; OSHC, materials and agent commission paid to third parties not refunded. Requires copy of refusal notification. No refund if fraudulent/forged/misleading documents. Decision within 10 working days; paid within 4 weeks (appendix says 2 weeks).
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice 28 days or more before commencement: 80% of tuition less enrolment fee. Less than 28 days: 50% of tuition less enrolment fee. 10-day cooling-off after signing written agreement and paying: 100% of tuition refunded.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (non-refundable in all circumstances incl. visa refusal; amount not stated - see Schedule of Fees); OSHC, bank charges, materials and agent commission already paid to third parties.
items.provider_default: If course does not start or stops: College tries to transfer student to another provider or refunds tuition for the unfinished portion within 2 weeks of the default date with a statement; TPS notified within 3 business days.
items.document: Fees Management & Refund Policy and Procedure (ASTAR Training Institute Pty Ltd t/a Be Qualified) - V1, June 2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused (genuine refusal, not due to false documents), tuition is refunded 100% except the enrolment fee, with the refusal letter as proof. Withdrawal ≥28 days before start: 80% of tuition refunded; <28 days: 50%; no refund after start. Enrolment fee, OSHC, materials and agent commission are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ (เป็นการปฏิเสธจริง ไม่ได้เกิดจากเอกสารเท็จ) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียน 100% ยกเว้นค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน โดยใช้จดหมายปฏิเสธเป็นหลักฐาน ถอนตัว ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 80%; <28 วัน: 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน OSHC ค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน และค่าคอมมิชชันเอเจนต์ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối (từ chối thực sự, không phải do giấy tờ giả), học phí được hoàn 100% trừ phí ghi danh, với thư từ chối làm bằng chứng. Rút học ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 80% học phí; <28 ngày: 50%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Phí ghi danh, OSHC, tài liệu và hoa hồng đại lý không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒（真实拒签，非因虚假文件所致），凭拒签信 100% 退还学费，注册费除外。开课前 ≥28 天退学：退还 80% 学费；<28 天：50%；开课后不予退款。注册费、OSHC、教材和中介佣金不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合（虚偽の書類によらない正当な却下）、却下通知書を証明として、入学金を除き授業料が100%返金されます。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：授業料の80%を返金。28日未満：50%。開始後の返金はありません。入学金、OSHC、教材費、エージェント手数料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우(허위 서류로 인한 것이 아닌 실제 거절), 거절 서신을 증빙으로 제출하면 입학금을 제외한 수업료가 100% 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료 80% 환불, 28일 미만: 50%, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금, OSHC, 교재비, 에이전트 커미션은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ (ការបដិសេធពិតប្រាកដ មិនមែនដោយសារឯកសារក្លែងក្លាយ) ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ 100% លើកលែងតែថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន ដោយមានលិខិតបដិសេធជាភស្តុតាង។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 80%; <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន OSHC សម្ភារៈ និងកម្រៃជើងសារភ្នាក់ងារ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak (bukan karena dokumen palsu), tuition dikembalikan dikurangi biaya administrasi $500. Mundur ≥28 hari sebelum mulai: 70% tuition kembali, <28 hari: 50% (dikurangi $500 dan CoE fee); setelah tanggal mulai tidak ada refund. Enrolment fee $200 dan CoE fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused (not fraud/forged/misleading documents): offshore applications - tuition refund less $500 admin fee; onshore - before start full tuition less $500, after start unused tuition less $500. No refund if AAT review undertaken. If course can be delivered online offshore: unused tuition less $500 and CoE fee, if withdrawal requested before agreed start date. Evidence/time limit: not stated specifically.
items.withdraw_before_start: 28 days or more before agreed start date: 70% of tuition less $500 admin fee and CoE issuing fee. Less than 28 days: 50% of tuition less $500 and CoE fee. Not commencing: no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: Withdrawal after agreed start date: no refund. Enrolled students: unused tuition for following term(s) less $500 and CoE fee, if form received at least 28 days before the following term. No refund after approved deferment/suspension or visa cancellation due to student actions.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment/application fee $200 and CoE issuing fee (amount not stated).
items.provider_default: If course does not start, stops before completion or is affected by government sanction: TPS first seeks placement in another course, otherwise refund of unexpended tuition within 14 days of default day and receipt of Refund Application Form.
items.document: Berkeley Business Institute Student Pre-Enrolment Information (Refund Policy section) - Version 7.0, Jan 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused (not due to false documents), tuition is refunded minus a $500 administration fee. Withdrawal ≥28 days before start: 70% of tuition refunded; <28 days: 50% (minus $500 and the CoE fee); no refund after the start date. The $200 enrolment fee and CoE fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ (ไม่ได้เกิดจากเอกสารเท็จ) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ $500 ถอนตัว ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 70%; <28 วัน: 50% (หัก $500 และค่า CoE); ไม่คืนเงินหลังวันเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน $200 และค่า CoE ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối (không phải do giấy tờ giả), học phí được hoàn sau khi trừ phí hành chính $500. Rút học ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70% học phí; <28 ngày: 50% (trừ $500 và phí CoE); không hoàn tiền sau ngày khai giảng. Phí ghi danh $200 và phí CoE không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒（非因虚假文件所致），退还学费并扣除 $500 行政费。开课前 ≥28 天退学：退还 70% 学费；<28 天：50%（扣除 $500 和 CoE 费）；开课日期后不予退款。$200 注册费和 CoE 费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合（虚偽の書類によらない場合）、授業料から$500の事務手数料を差し引いて返金されます。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：授業料の70%を返金。28日未満：50%（$500とCoE費用を差し引き）。開始日以降の返金はありません。$200の入学金とCoE費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우(허위 서류로 인한 것이 아닌 경우), 수업료에서 $500 행정비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료 70% 환불, 28일 미만: 50%($500와 CoE 비용 공제), 개강일 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. $200 입학금과 CoE 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ (មិនមែនដោយសារឯកសារក្លែងក្លាយ) ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល $500។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 70%; <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50% (ដកចេញ $500 និងថ្លៃ CoE); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយថ្ងៃចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន $200 និងថ្លៃ CoE មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Cambridge Academy of English Pty Ltd t/a Cambridge College Australia (CCA)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund tuition yang belum terpakai, dikurangi administration fee (AUD 500), dengan bukti tertulis penolakan. Mundur ≥20 hari sebelum mulai refund 85% tuition, <20 hari atau setelah mulai tidak ada refund; administration/application fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: 100% refund of unused prepaid tuition fees; non-tuition administration fee not refunded (ESOS calculation: course fees minus administration fees of $500). Written evidence of refusal from the relevant authority required. Refund within 2 weeks. Application time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: 20 days or more before commencement (body text: twenty working days): 85% refund of unused prepaid tuition fees (15% administration fee retained). Less than 20 days: 0% refund (may transfer to a later intake).
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund. Incomplete units may be finalised in a future course using original fee as credit within 12 months of initial payment. Illness/injury with medical certificate: pro-rata refund.
items.non_refundable: Application for enrolment (administration) fee; 15% administration fee on early cancellation; agent fees; OSHC, equipment and books from other suppliers; bank charges/exchange differences. Materials fees refundable only pro-rata (Refunds web page).
items.provider_default: Full refund of tuition fees paid within 14 days, or alternate course if student agrees in writing; TPS as backup.
items.document: Refund Policy and Procedure (National Code 2018 Standard 3) - not stated (file uploaded Feb 2025)
items.summary_en: Visa refused: refund of unused tuition minus the administration fee (AUD 500), with written proof of refusal. Withdrawal ≥20 days before start: 85% tuition refund; <20 days or after start: no refund; administration/application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ใช้หักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ (AUD 500) โดยต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษร ถอนตัว ≥20 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 85%; <20 วันหรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน; ไม่คืนค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ/ค่าสมัคร ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn học phí chưa sử dụng sau khi trừ phí hành chính (AUD 500), kèm bằng chứng bị từ chối bằng văn bản. Rút học ≥20 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 85% học phí; <20 ngày hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền; phí hành chính/nộp hồ sơ không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：凭书面拒签证明退还未使用的学费，扣除行政费（AUD 500）。开课前 ≥20 天退学：退还 85% 学费；<20 天或开课后：不予退款；行政/申请费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：却下の書面による証明があれば、未使用の授業料から事務手数料（AUD 500）を差し引いて返金。開始の20日以上前の取り下げ：授業料の85%を返金。20日未満または開始後：返金なし。事務手数料/出願料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자 거절 시: 서면 거절 증빙을 제출하면 미사용 수업료에서 행정비(AUD 500)를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 20일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료 85% 환불, 20일 미만 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 행정비/지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ៖ សងវិញនូវថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល (AUD 500) ដោយមានភស្តុតាងជាលាយលក្ខណ៍អក្សរនៃការបដិសេធ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥20 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 85%; <20 ថ្ងៃ ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ; ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល/ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Australian Campus Management Pty Ltd (trading as Canterbury Institute of Management)
items.visa_refused: Refund for visa rejection requires copy of the rejection notice and official receipt. COE fees (tuition for 50% of selected courses) are non-refundable after the Census Date except for visa rejection. No refund if Home Affairs finds the visa was refused for fraud. Refund amount not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Full tuition refund without penalty if the student withdraws on or before the census date (as stated in the brochure).
items.withdraw_after_start: No tuition refund once the applicable semester has commenced (as stated in the brochure; brochure also refers to census date).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (international), revised eCoE fee, late payment fee, library late return / lost item fees.
items.provider_default: Full refund if the Institute cannot offer the program; under TPS, unspent prepaid fees may go to a new provider or be refunded.

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund biaya dipotong AUD 500 atau 5% (mana yang lebih kecil), wajib bukti resmi. Mundur sebelum mulai: 75% (>28 hari) atau 50% (1–28 hari) dikurangi AUD 300; setelah mulai tidak ada refund; biaya enrolment tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before start (written request before the agreed course package commencement date): full course fees paid in advance less AUD 500 or 5% of fees paid, whichever is lesser; official evidence of refusal required. After start: unspent tuition less AUD 300 administration fee (ESOS calculation).
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 28 calendar days before start: 75% of advance tuition (per course) less AUD 300; 1-28 days: 50% less AUD 300. Deferring does not extend refund period.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of advance fees. No refund also for visa cancellation, not starting without withdrawing, or refusal/termination for unpaid fees, visa breach, policy breach or misbehaviour.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (always); OSHC (if paid to CAPSTONE) and materials fee once course package has commenced.
items.provider_default: Refund of unspent tuition or alternative course with written agreement, within 14 calendar days of default day; otherwise Tuition Protection Service.
items.document: Refund Policy - CAPSTONE Institute of Australia (CRICOS 04051A, RTO 45903) - not stated
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: refund minus AUD 500 or 5% (whichever is less); official proof required. Withdrawal before start: 75% (>28 days) or 50% (1–28 days) minus AUD 300; no refund after start; the enrolment fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินหักออก AUD 500 หรือ 5% (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); ต้องมีหลักฐานทางการ ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: 75% (>28 วัน) หรือ 50% (1–28 วัน) หัก AUD 300; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn tiền sau khi trừ AUD 500 hoặc 5% (tùy số nào thấp hơn); cần có bằng chứng chính thức. Rút học trước khi khai giảng: 75% (>28 ngày) hoặc 50% (1–28 ngày) trừ AUD 300; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí ghi danh không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退款扣除 AUD 500 或 5%（以较低者为准）；需提供官方证明。开课前退学：75%（>28 天）或 50%（1–28 天），扣除 AUD 300；开课后不予退款；注册费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：AUD 500または5%（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金。公式な証明が必要です。開始前の取り下げ：75%（28日超前）または50%（1〜28日前）からAUD 300を差し引き。開始後の返金はありません。入学金は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: AUD 500 또는 5%(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제한 후 환불되며, 공식 증빙이 필요합니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 75%(28일 초과) 또는 50%(1–28일)에서 AUD 300 공제, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ ដកចេញ AUD 500 ឬ 5% (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ត្រូវមានភស្តុតាងផ្លូវការ។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 75% (>28 ថ្ងៃ) ឬ 50% (1–28 ថ្ងៃ) ដកចេញ AUD 300; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak (dengan bukti), tuition fee dikembalikan dikurangi biaya admin AUD 500 atau 5% (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur minimal 4 minggu sebelum mulai dipotong 20% sisa tuition, kurang dari 4 minggu dipotong 30%; untuk VET dalam 4 minggu pertama setelah mulai dipotong 50%, setelah census date tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Student visa application unsuccessful and written evidence of the visa decision given to CDU: prepaid tuition and Student Services and Amenities Fee refunded less an administration fee of AUD 500 or 5% of prepaid tuition, whichever is the lesser (cl. 32). Applications normally not accepted if lodged more than 12 months after the end of the relevant study period.
items.withdraw_before_start: Withdrawal using International refund form (VET and HE): at least four weeks before start – 20% of remaining tuition fee balance retained; less than four weeks before start – 30% retained (scholarship benefits recouped first).
items.withdraw_after_start: VET: within first four weeks after start – 50% of remaining tuition fee balance retained. HE: after start but before census – 50% retained. After census: fees for that study period not refunded.
items.non_refundable: Administration fee on visa refusal; fees for withdrawals after census; fees for students excluded through disciplinary action; excess/advance fees credited to future periods instead of refunded.
items.provider_default: If CDU cancels a unit/course: student notified in writing and may transfer within CDU, transfer to another institution, or request refund of prepaid tuition for uncompleted units; refund paid within 14 days of the course start date or the date CDU stops providing it.
items.document: International Student Fee Policy (Charles Darwin University) - not stated (current version in CDU governance document library)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused (with proof), tuition fees are refunded minus an admin fee of AUD 500 or 5% (whichever is less). Withdrawal at least 4 weeks before start: 20% of remaining tuition deducted; less than 4 weeks: 30% deducted; for VET, within the first 4 weeks after start: 50% deducted; no refund after the census date. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ (มีหลักฐาน) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 500 หรือ 5% (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวอย่างน้อย 4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: หัก 20% ของค่าเล่าเรียนที่เหลือ; น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์: หัก 30%; สำหรับ VET ภายใน 4 สัปดาห์แรกหลังเริ่มเรียน: หัก 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลัง census date ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối (có bằng chứng), học phí được hoàn sau khi trừ phí hành chính AUD 500 hoặc 5% (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học ít nhất 4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: khấu trừ 20% học phí còn lại; dưới 4 tuần: khấu trừ 30%; đối với VET, trong 4 tuần đầu sau khi khai giảng: khấu trừ 50%; không hoàn tiền sau census date. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒（需提供证明），退还学费并扣除 AUD 500 或 5% 的行政费（以较低者为准）。开课前至少 4 周退学：扣除剩余学费的 20%；不足 4 周：扣除 30%；VET 课程开课后前 4 周内：扣除 50%；census date 之后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合（証明あり）、授業料からAUD 500または5%（いずれか少ない方）の事務手数料を差し引いて返金されます。開始の少なくとも4週間前の取り下げ：残りの授業料の20%を差し引き。4週間未満：30%を差し引き。VETの場合、開始後最初の4週間以内：50%を差し引き。census date 以降の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우(증빙 제출 시), 수업료에서 AUD 500 또는 5%(둘 중 적은 금액)의 행정비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 최소 4주 전 철회 시: 잔여 수업료의 20% 공제, 4주 미만: 30% 공제, VET의 경우 개강 후 첫 4주 이내: 50% 공제, census date 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ (មានភស្តុតាង) ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 500 ឬ 5% (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនយ៉ាងហោចណាស់ 4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ កាត់ 20% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលនៅសល់; តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍៖ កាត់ 30%; សម្រាប់ VET ក្នុងរយៈពេល 4 សប្តាហ៍ដំបូងក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ កាត់ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយថ្ងៃ census date ទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: ECA Higher Education Institute Pty Ltd t/as ECA College of Health Sciences (CHS)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund semua biaya dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil), wajib bukti penolakan, ajukan maksimal 6 bulan. Mundur ≥4 minggu sebelum mulai dipotong biaya 1 unit + AUD 500, <4 minggu dipotong 2 unit + AUD 500; setelah mulai umumnya tidak ada refund untuk periode berjalan; application/enrolment fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before commencement (not fraud): all course fees paid less the lesser of 5% of course fees received or AUD 500; proof of refusal required; apply up to 6 months after proposed commencement date. Visa application fee may be reimbursed up to AUD 2,500 case by case (only students from listed countries with visa approval rate above 80%, with evidence). After commencement: weekly tuition fee x weeks remaining in paid study period after default day; non-tuition fees not refunded. Fraud/misleading info: no refund.
items.withdraw_before_start: Notice of 4 or more weeks before study period start: 1 unit fee plus $500 administration fee retained, rest of prepaid tuition refunded. Within 4 weeks of start (incl. non-commencement): 2 unit fees plus $500 administration fee retained. Before CoE issued: full refund less $500 administration fee. Deferral: fees held as credit.
items.withdraw_after_start: Before completing 6 months of principal course, withdrawing after census date: no refund for study periods starting in first 6 months (later prepaid periods refunded). After 6 months: before study period starts full refund of prepaid tuition; between start and census date 1 unit fee + $500 retained; after census date no refund for that period.
items.non_refundable: Application/enrolment fee; CoE processing fee; suspension fee; late payment fee; RPL fee; ancillary charges incl. card surcharges; graduation fees; library fines; re-mark fees; replacement ID; international postage; photocopying credits. OSHC refunded in full if visa refused or withdraw before commencement.
items.provider_default: Full refund of prepaid course/tuition fees if course cannot be offered/completed, within 14 days of default day, or alternative course at no additional cost; TPS support.
items.document: Refund Policy (PHE006) - covers APIC, HELI and ECA College of Health Sciences - Version 1.1, effective 20 July 2026
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: refund of all fees minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less); proof of refusal required; apply within 6 months. Withdrawal ≥4 weeks before start: deduction of 1 unit's fee + AUD 500; <4 weeks: 2 units + AUD 500; generally no refund for the current period after start; application/enrolment fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); ต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธ; ยื่นขอภายใน 6 เดือน ถอนตัว ≥4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: หักค่าเรียน 1 unit + AUD 500; <4 สัปดาห์: 2 unit + AUD 500; โดยทั่วไปไม่คืนเงินของช่วงเวลาปัจจุบันหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร/ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn); cần có bằng chứng bị từ chối; nộp yêu cầu trong vòng 6 tháng. Rút học ≥4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: khấu trừ phí của 1 học phần (unit) + AUD 500; <4 tuần: 2 học phần + AUD 500; thông thường không hoàn tiền cho kỳ hiện tại sau khi khai giảng; phí nộp hồ sơ/ghi danh không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还全部费用，扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）；需提供拒签证明；须在 6 个月内申请。开课前 ≥4 周退学：扣除 1 个单元的费用 + AUD 500；<4 周：2 个单元 + AUD 500；开课后当期费用一般不予退还；申请/注册费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：全費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金。却下の証明が必要で、6か月以内に申請する必要があります。開始の4週間以上前の取り下げ：1ユニット分の費用＋AUD 500を差し引き。4週間未満：2ユニット分＋AUD 500。開始後は原則として当該期間の返金はありません。出願料/入学金は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 모든 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, 거절 증빙이 필요하고 6개월 이내에 신청해야 합니다. 개강 4주 이상 전 철회 시: 1개 유닛 비용 + AUD 500 공제, 4주 미만: 2개 유닛 비용 + AUD 500 공제, 개강 후에는 일반적으로 현재 기간에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비/입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញនូវថ្លៃទាំងអស់ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ត្រូវមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធ; ត្រូវដាក់ពាក្យក្នុងរយៈពេល 6 ខែ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ កាត់ថ្លៃ 1 unit + AUD 500; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 2 units + AUD 500; ជាទូទៅមិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់រយៈពេលបច្ចុប្បន្នក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ/ចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, biaya dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau $500 (mana yang lebih kecil), asalkan ada bukti penolakan visa. Mundur secara tertulis ≥28 hari sebelum mulai: refund dikurangi 10%; <28 hari: deposit hangus; setelah kursus mulai tidak ada refund untuk biaya yang sudah berjalan. Application fee $250 dan material fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Not yet attended classes: refund of total course fees received (tuition + non-tuition) less the lesser of 5% or $500. Already attended classes: refund of unspent tuition less admin fee (lesser of 5% of total tuition or $500); spent tuition, material fee and $250 application fee not refunded. No refund if refusal is due to false/misleading information. Evidence: Application for Withdrawal Form, Refund Application Form and proof of visa refusal. Time limit: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice 28 days or more before commencement: total course fees paid less 10%. Less than 28 days before commencement: deposit not refunded. Material fee and $250 application fee non-refundable in both cases. Withdrawal subject to college approval.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of the spent portion of tuition for the current course; outstanding tuition scheduled in the Letter of Offer becomes payable. Same applies to cancellation for visa/suspension breach. Material fee and $250 application fee non-refundable.
items.non_refundable: Application fee $250 (non-refundable in all circumstances); enrolment fee (amount not stated); material fee in withdrawal/breach cases; paid RPL assessment fee; any fee not listed in the refund section.
items.provider_default: If the college fails to start the course on the agreed day or stops delivering it: refund of unspent tuition within 14 days of the default day, or an alternative course at no extra cost; if neither, the Tuition Protection Service (TPS) assists.
items.document: CPPS011 Fees and Refund Policy and Procedures - Version 3.1, 01 Aug 2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, fees are refunded minus 5% or $500 (whichever is less), provided there is proof of visa refusal. Written withdrawal ≥28 days before start: refund minus 10%; <28 days: deposit forfeited; after the course starts, no refund for fees already in progress. The $250 application fee and material fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนค่าเรียนหักออก 5% หรือ $500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) โดยต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า แจ้งถอนตัวเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษร ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินหัก 10%; <28 วัน: ริบเงินมัดจำ; หลังเริ่มหลักสูตร ไม่คืนค่าเรียนส่วนที่อยู่ระหว่างการเรียน ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร $250 และค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, các khoản phí được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc $500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn), với điều kiện có bằng chứng bị từ chối visa. Rút học bằng văn bản ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn tiền trừ 10%; <28 ngày: mất khoản đặt cọc; sau khi khóa học bắt đầu, không hoàn các khoản phí cho phần đang học. Phí nộp hồ sơ $250 và phí tài liệu không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，在提供拒签证明的前提下，退还费用并扣除 5% 或 $500（以较低者为准）。开课前 ≥28 天书面退学：退款扣除 10%；<28 天：订金不予退还；课程开始后，已进行中的费用不予退还。$250 申请费和教材费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、ビザ却下の証明があることを条件に、費用から5%または$500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始の28日以上前に書面で取り下げた場合：10%を差し引いて返金。28日未満：デポジットは没収。コース開始後は、すでに進行中の期間の費用は返金されません。$250の出願料と教材費は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 비자 거절 증빙이 있으면 비용에서 5% 또는 $500(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 서면 철회 시: 10% 공제 후 환불, 28일 미만: 보증금 몰수, 코스 시작 후에는 이미 진행 중인 기간의 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. $250 지원비와 교재비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ $500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ដរាបណាមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួនជាលាយលក្ខណ៍អក្សរ ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ ដកចេញ 10%; <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ បាត់បង់ប្រាក់កក់; ក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើម មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់ថ្លៃដែលកំពុងដំណើរការទេ។ ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ $250 និងថ្លៃសម្ភារៈ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund 100%, kecuali biaya enrolment AUD 200. Mundur ≥29 hari sebelum mulai: refund 80%; kurang dari 28 hari: 0%; setelah mulai (VET) tidak ada refund kecuali keadaan compassionate. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: 100% refund (AUD 200 enrolment fee non-refundable). After start: non-tuition fees not refunded; ELICOS tuition refunded weekly from default day; VET: no refund. 0% if refusal relates to not starting, withdrawing or not paying.
items.withdraw_before_start: 29 or more days before commencement: 80% refund; less than 28 days: 0%. Deferred students: from original start date, tuition only.
items.withdraw_after_start: not stated (no percentage for voluntary withdrawal after commencement). Compassionate/compelling circumstances may be considered: total fees less lower of 5% or AUD 500 (may be waived).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee AUD 200; CoE issue fee, late payment fee AUD 120, deferment/suspension/withdrawal fee AUD 400, cancellation fee AUD 400, change of course fee AUD 200, and other admin fees marked in fee table. 0% refund for termination (policy breach, progress/attendance), visa breach, false information.
items.provider_default: Full refund.
items.document: Student Handbook SC16.1 (Collins Institute of Australia Pty Ltd, RTO 45161, CRICOS 03603D) - Version 2.2, updated 25 March 2026
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: 100% refund, except the AUD 200 enrolment fee. Withdrawal ≥29 days before start: 80% refund; less than 28 days: 0%; after start (VET): no refund except in compassionate circumstances. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 100% ยกเว้นค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 200 ถอนตัว ≥29 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 80%; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: 0%; หลังเริ่มเรียน (VET): ไม่คืนเงิน ยกเว้นกรณีเหตุจำเป็นอันน่าเห็นใจ (compassionate circumstances) ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100%, trừ phí ghi danh AUD 200. Rút học ≥29 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 80%; dưới 28 ngày: 0%; sau khi khai giảng (VET): không hoàn tiền trừ trường hợp có lý do nhân đạo/hoàn cảnh đặc biệt. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：100% 退款，AUD 200 注册费除外。开课前 ≥29 天退学：退还 80%；不足 28 天：0%；开课后（VET）：不予退款，恩恤情况除外。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：AUD 200の入学金を除き100%返金。開始の29日以上前の取り下げ：80%返金。28日未満：0%。開始後（VET）：やむを得ない事情（compassionate circumstances）の場合を除き返金なし。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: AUD 200 입학금을 제외하고 100% 환불됩니다. 개강 29일 이상 전 철회 시: 80% 환불, 28일 미만: 0%, 개강 후(VET): 인도적 사유(compassionate circumstances)를 제외하고 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 100% លើកលែងតែថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 200។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥29 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 80%; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 0%; ក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន (VET)៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ លើកលែងតែក្នុងកាលៈទេសៈមនុស្សធម៌។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Career Solutions Group Pty Ltd The Trustee for Career Solutions Trust (trading as Collins International College)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Collins International College memotong 5% biaya kuliah atau $500 (mana yang lebih kecil) dan mengembalikan sisanya, tanpa refund registration/administration fee. Mundur 60 hari atau lebih sebelum mulai mendapat refund serupa, 28-60 hari 50%, kurang dari 28 hari atau setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before start: lower of 5% of tuition initially paid or $500 deducted, remainder refunded; registration and administration fees not refunded; must apply to cancel before commencement with the refusal letter. After start: refund calculated with the refund calculator (unused weeks); non-tuition fees not refunded. Visa extension refused or visa cancelled due to student actions (onshore, after start): no refund.
items.withdraw_before_start: 60+ days before start: tuition refunded less lower of 5% or $500. Less than 60 but more than 28 days: 50% of tuition. Less than 28 days: no refund of any fees. Registration, administration and other non-tuition fees not refunded.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund, except extenuating circumstances (illness, family/personal matters, verified departure from Australia) decided by the CEO; change of mind, change of course or transfer does not qualify.
items.non_refundable: Registration fee and administration fee; other non-tuition fees; airport pick-up, homestay and accommodation booking fees.
items.provider_default: Course not available before start: full refund of course fees. Not fully delivered: full refund of course and materials fees paid to date or an alternative course at no extra cost, within 14 days; otherwise TPS. No application needed.
items.document: Fees & Refund Policy and Procedure - V3.0, January 2024
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Collins International College deducts 5% of tuition fees or $500 (whichever is less) and refunds the rest, with no refund of the registration/administration fee. Withdrawal 60 days or more before start: similar refund; 28-60 days: 50%; less than 28 days or after start: no refund. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Collins International College จะหัก 5% ของค่าเล่าเรียนหรือ $500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) และคืนส่วนที่เหลือ โดยไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียน/ค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ ถอนตัว 60 วันขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินในลักษณะเดียวกัน; 28-60 วัน: 50%; น้อยกว่า 28 วันหรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Collins International College khấu trừ 5% học phí hoặc $500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn) và hoàn phần còn lại, không hoàn phí đăng ký/phí hành chính. Rút học từ 60 ngày trở lên trước khi khai giảng: hoàn tương tự; 28-60 ngày: 50%; dưới 28 ngày hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Collins International College 扣除学费的 5% 或 $500（以较低者为准）后退还其余部分，注册/行政费不予退还。开课前 60 天或以上退学：退款方式类似；28-60 天：50%；不足 28 天或开课后：不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Collins International Collegeは授業料の5%または$500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて残額を返金し、登録料/事務手数料は返金しません。開始の60日以上前の取り下げ：同様の返金。28〜60日前：50%。28日未満または開始後：返金なし。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Collins International College는 수업료의 5% 또는 $500(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제하고 나머지를 환불하며, 등록비/행정비는 환불되지 않습니다. 개강 60일 이상 전 철회 시: 유사한 환불, 28-60일: 50%, 28일 미만 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Collins International College កាត់ 5% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា ឬ $500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ហើយសងវិញនូវចំនួនដែលនៅសល់ ដោយមិនសងថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះ/ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាលវិញទេ។ ការដកខ្លួន 60 ថ្ងៃ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញស្រដៀងគ្នា; 28-60 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak (dengan bukti resmi DHA), tuition fee dan OSHC dikembalikan, dipotong enrolment fee, biaya withdrawal AUD 200 dan admin AUD 200. Mundur 28 hari atau lebih sebelum mulai refund 70%, kurang dari itu refund 50%; setelah kursus mulai tidak ada refund; enrolment fee tidak dikembalikan dalam kondisi apa pun. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused: all course money paid such as tuition fees and OSHC refunded, except enrolment fee, additional-service fees, AUD 200 withdrawal fee and AUD 200 admin fee for CoE cancellation. Certified DHA evidence of refusal required. No refund if refusal based on fraud as determined by DHA. Paid within 30 days of written claim.
items.withdraw_before_start: Notice 28 days or more before commencement: 70% of tuition fees received refunded. 27 days or fewer: 50% of tuition fees refunded (only if 4 units of tuition fees received). AUD 200 withdrawal fee on all withdrawal applications.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of tuition fees if the student cancels/terminates after the course has commenced.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fees (non-refundable under any circumstances); AUD 200 withdrawal fee; AUD 200 CoE cancellation admin fee (visa refusal); additional services (accommodation/homestay placement, airport pick-up, etc.).
items.provider_default: If CIHE defaults (course not started on agreed date, ceases, or not fully provided due to sanction): full refund if before commencement, refund of unused fees if after; paid within 2 weeks of default, or student may accept another CIHE course; TPS backstop.
items.document: International Student Withdrawal and Refund Policy (QA36) - Version 2.2, approved 24.05.2023 (next review 23 May 2026)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused (with official DHA proof), tuition fees and OSHC are refunded, minus the enrolment fee, an AUD 200 withdrawal fee and an AUD 200 admin fee. Withdrawal 28 days or more before start: 70% refund; less than that: 50% refund; no refund after the course starts; the enrolment fee is not refunded under any circumstances. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ (มีหลักฐานทางการจาก DHA) จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนและ OSHC หักค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ค่าธรรมเนียมการถอนตัว AUD 200 และค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 200 ถอนตัว 28 วันขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 70%; น้อยกว่านั้น: คืน 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร; ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียนไม่ว่ากรณีใด ๆ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối (có bằng chứng chính thức của DHA), học phí và OSHC được hoàn, sau khi trừ phí ghi danh, phí rút học AUD 200 và phí hành chính AUD 200. Rút học từ 28 ngày trở lên trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70%; ít hơn thời hạn đó: hoàn 50%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khóa học bắt đầu; phí ghi danh không được hoàn trong bất kỳ trường hợp nào. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒（需提供 DHA 官方证明），退还学费和 OSHC，扣除注册费、AUD 200 退学费和 AUD 200 行政费。开课前 28 天或以上退学：退还 70%；少于此期限：退还 50%；课程开始后不予退款；注册费在任何情况下均不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合（DHAの公式な証明あり）、授業料とOSHCが返金されます。ただし、入学金、AUD 200の取り下げ手数料、AUD 200の事務手数料が差し引かれます。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：70%返金。それ未満：50%返金。コース開始後の返金はありません。入学金はいかなる場合も返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우(DHA 공식 증빙 제출 시), 수업료와 OSHC는 입학금, AUD 200 철회 수수료, AUD 200 행정비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 70% 환불, 그 미만: 50% 환불, 코스 시작 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금은 어떠한 경우에도 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ (មានភស្តុតាងផ្លូវការពី DHA) ថ្លៃសិក្សា និង OSHC ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន ថ្លៃដកខ្លួន AUD 200 និងថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 200។ ការដកខ្លួន 28 ថ្ងៃ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 70%; តិចជាងនេះ៖ សងវិញ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើមទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញក្នុងកាលៈទេសៈណាមួយឡើយ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, biaya dikembalikan penuh dikurangi biaya administrasi (dokumen menyebut $300) dengan bukti penolakan visa. Mundur >60 hari sebelum mulai: refund dikurangi $300; 28–60 hari: 70% tuition kembali dikurangi $300; <28 hari: tuition tidak kembali; setelah mulai umumnya tidak ada refund. Biaya non-tuition setelah mulai dan biaya RPL tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: full refund of fees received less the Administration Fee (refund section says $300; fee table says 5% of amount paid or $500 whichever is lesser - document is inconsistent). Proof of refusal from the Department required, otherwise no refund. After course start: refund of unused tuition for the current study period (with refusal letter). Time limit: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice. More than 60 days before start (or within 3-day cooling-off): full refund less $300 admin fee. Less than 60 but more than 28 days: 70% of tuition and 100% of materials fee refunded, less $300 admin fee. Less than 28 days: materials fee refunded, no tuition refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund (student invoiced for tuition up to CoE cancellation) unless confirmed extenuating circumstances, in which case unused tuition for the current study period may be refunded or transferred (CEO decides). No refund for transfer before 6 months, misconduct/visa breach, or abandonment. Non-tuition fees not refunded after start.
items.non_refundable: Non-tuition fees after course start; RPL fee $250 per unit; materials fee ($500) not refunded after start; third-party fees (health insurance, agent fees); refund bank charges up to $40 deducted.
items.provider_default: Course not started: full refund of tuition within 10 business days of start date; course cannot be completed: refund of unused tuition; or replacement course at no extra cost if student agrees; fees protected by TPS.
items.document: Policy and Procedure: Fees, Charges and Refunds 2025 - Version 2.0, July 2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, fees are refunded in full minus an administration fee (the document states $300), with proof of visa refusal. Withdrawal >60 days before start: refund minus $300; 28–60 days: 70% of tuition refunded minus $300; <28 days: tuition not refunded; generally no refund after start. Non-tuition fees after start and RPL fees are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าเรียนเต็มจำนวนหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ (เอกสารระบุ $300) โดยต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัว >60 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินหัก $300; 28–60 วัน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 70% หัก $300; <28 วัน: ไม่คืนค่าเล่าเรียน; โดยทั่วไปไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าใช้จ่ายที่ไม่ใช่ค่าเล่าเรียนหลังเริ่มเรียนและค่า RPL ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, các khoản phí được hoàn đầy đủ sau khi trừ phí hành chính (tài liệu ghi $300), kèm bằng chứng bị từ chối visa. Rút học >60 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn tiền trừ $300; 28–60 ngày: hoàn 70% học phí trừ $300; <28 ngày: không hoàn học phí; thông thường không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Các khoản phí ngoài học phí sau khi khai giảng và phí RPL không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，凭拒签证明全额退还费用，扣除行政费（文件注明为 $300）。开课前 >60 天退学：退款扣除 $300；28–60 天：退还 70% 学费并扣除 $300；<28 天：学费不予退还；开课后一般不予退款。开课后的非学费费用及 RPL 费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、ビザ却下の証明があれば、事務手数料（書類には$300と記載）を差し引いて全額返金されます。開始の60日超前の取り下げ：$300を差し引いて返金。28〜60日前：授業料の70%から$300を差し引いて返金。28日未満：授業料は返金されません。開始後は原則として返金なし。開始後の授業料以外の費用とRPL費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 비자 거절 증빙을 제출하면 행정비(문서상 $300)를 공제한 후 전액 환불됩니다. 개강 60일 초과 전 철회 시: $300 공제 후 환불, 28–60일: 수업료의 70%에서 $300 공제 후 환불, 28일 미만: 수업료 환불 불가, 개강 후에는 일반적으로 환불되지 않습니다. 개강 후 수업료 외 비용과 RPL 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃត្រូវបានសងវិញទាំងស្រុង ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល (ឯកសារបញ្ជាក់ $300) ដោយមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួន >60 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ ដកចេញ $300; 28–60 ថ្ងៃ៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 70% ដកចេញ $300; <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ ថ្លៃសិក្សាមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ; ជាទូទៅមិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃមិនមែនថ្លៃសិក្សាក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន និងថ្លៃ RPL មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Education Centre of Australia (ECA College), RTO 45012
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund tuition dan biaya lain dikurangi enrolment fee serta 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil), wajib surat penolakan visa. Mundur >4 minggu sebelum mulai refund 100% tuition (dikurangi enrolment fee), 2–4 minggu 70%, 1–2 minggu 50%, <1 minggu atau setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Full refund of tuition (or CoE security deposit) plus non-tuition fees, minus the enrolment fee and the lesser of 5% of course fees received or $500; full OSHC refund. Evidence: verified copy of the original visa rejection letter. Time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 4 weeks (28 days) before commencement: 100% tuition minus enrolment fee (materials and OSHC 100%). 4 to 2 weeks: 70% tuition (Schedule C says 75%) minus enrolment fee. 2 to 1 week: 50% minus enrolment fee. Less than 1 week: 0%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of tuition, materials or enrolment fees. Compassionate circumstances: part refund of unspent tuition.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (deducted from most refunds); materials fee within 7 days of start or after start; agency fees; no refund for CoE cancelled for visa/enrolment breach. OSHC after commencement (document is inconsistent).
items.provider_default: If course cancelled without equivalent alternative: full refund of enrolment fee, tuition/CoE deposit and non-tuition fees (Schedule B: 100% refund of enrolment, materials and tuition fees).
items.document: Fees and Refund Policy and Procedures (ECA group; linked from https://www.ecacollege.edu.au/forms) - not stated
items.summary_en: Visa refused: refund of tuition and other fees minus the enrolment fee and 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less); visa refusal letter required. Withdrawal >4 weeks before start: 100% tuition refund (minus the enrolment fee); 2–4 weeks: 70%; 1–2 weeks: 50%; <1 week or after start: no refund. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนและค่าใช้จ่ายอื่น ๆ หักค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน และ 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); ต้องมีจดหมายปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัว >4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียน 100% (หักค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน); 2–4 สัปดาห์: 70%; 1–2 สัปดาห์: 50%; <1 สัปดาห์หรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn học phí và các khoản phí khác sau khi trừ phí ghi danh và 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn); cần có thư từ chối visa. Rút học >4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100% học phí (trừ phí ghi danh); 2–4 tuần: 70%; 1–2 tuần: 50%; <1 tuần hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：退还学费及其他费用，扣除注册费以及 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）；需提供拒签信。开课前 >4 周退学：退还 100% 学费（扣除注册费）；2–4 周：70%；1–2 周：50%；<1 周或开课后：不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：授業料およびその他の費用から入学金と、5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金。ビザ却下通知書が必要です。開始の4週間超前の取り下げ：授業料を100%返金（入学金を差し引き）。2〜4週間前：70%。1〜2週間前：50%。1週間未満または開始後：返金なし。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자 거절 시: 수업료 및 기타 비용에서 입학금과 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, 비자 거절 서신이 필요합니다. 개강 4주 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료 100% 환불(입학금 공제), 2–4주: 70%, 1–2주: 50%, 1주 미만 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ៖ សងវិញនូវថ្លៃសិក្សា និងថ្លៃផ្សេងៗ ដកចេញថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន និង 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ត្រូវមានលិខិតបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួន >4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ 100% (ដកចេញថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន); 2–4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 70%; 1–2 សប្តាហ៍៖ 50%; <1 សប្តាហ៍ ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund 100% (kecuali biaya enrolment AUD 200, penjemputan bandara, homestay); setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Mundur ≥29 hari sebelum mulai: refund 80%; kurang dari 28 hari: 0%. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: 100% refund (non-refundable fees excluded). After start: no fees refunded. 0% if refusal due to not starting, withdrawing or not paying fees.
items.withdraw_before_start: 29 days or more before commencement: 80% refund; less than 28 days: 0%. Deferred students: from original start date, tuition only.
items.withdraw_after_start: not stated (full refund only for college default; compassionate circumstances may be considered).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment application fee AUD 200, airport pick-up and homestay placement fee (under any circumstances incl. visa rejection); late payment fee, deferment/suspension/withdrawal fee AUD 400, cancellation fee AUD 400, change of course fee AUD 200; all non-tuition fees for deferred students. Agent fees not refunded.
items.provider_default: ESOS Act applies; TPS places student in another course, otherwise refund of unexpended tuition.
items.document: Terms and Conditions - International Students (Eton College Pty Ltd, CRICOS 03908J, RTO 45679) - not stated
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: 100% refund (except the AUD 200 enrolment fee, airport pick-up and homestay); no refund after start. Withdrawal ≥29 days before start: 80% refund; less than 28 days: 0%. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 100% (ยกเว้นค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 200 ค่าบริการรับที่สนามบิน และค่าโฮมสเตย์); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ถอนตัว ≥29 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 80%; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: 0% ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100% (trừ phí ghi danh AUD 200, phí đón sân bay và homestay); không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Rút học ≥29 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 80%; dưới 28 ngày: 0%. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：100% 退款（AUD 200 注册费、接机和寄宿家庭费用除外）；开课后不予退款。开课前 ≥29 天退学：退还 80%；不足 28 天：0%。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：100%返金（AUD 200の入学金、空港送迎、ホームステイを除く）。開始後の返金はありません。開始の29日以上前の取り下げ：80%返金。28日未満：0%。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 100% 환불(AUD 200 입학금, 공항 픽업, 홈스테이 제외), 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 개강 29일 이상 전 철회 시: 80% 환불, 28일 미만: 0%. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 100% (លើកលែងតែថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 200 សេវាទទួលពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ និង homestay); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥29 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 80%; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 0%។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Everthought College of Construction Pty Ltd
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: semua biaya dikembalikan dikurangi admin fee AUD 350; sampai 28 hari setelah mulai hanya 30% tuition dikurangi AUD 350. Mundur >28 hari sebelum mulai refund 70% tuition + biaya materi (dikurangi AUD 350), <28 hari 50% tuition, ≤28 hari setelah mulai 30%, lebih dari itu tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before commencement: all fees minus non-refundable AUD 350 administration fee. Up to 28 days after commencement: 30% of tuition fees minus AUD 350 (no refund of learning materials/consumables). After 28 days from commencement: nil. Evidence/time limit: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 28 days before commencement: 100% of learning materials and consumables fees + 70% of tuition fees, minus AUD 350. Less than 28 days before: 50% of tuition fees minus AUD 350; no refund of materials/consumables.
items.withdraw_after_start: Within 28 days after commencement: 30% of tuition fees minus AUD 350 (no materials/consumables refund). More than 28 days after commencement: nil. Same scale (without AUD 350) applies to subsequent terms.
items.non_refundable: AUD 350 administration fee; learning materials/consumables once within 28 days of start; RPL charges; costs already incurred for incidental fees. Disciplinary cancellation (e.g. fraud): all fees forfeited. OSHC refunds via OSHC provider.
items.provider_default: Unspent fees refunded within two weeks, or student may choose another course.
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refund Policy (PP07) - Version 4.0, February 2024
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: all fees refunded minus an AUD 350 admin fee; up to 28 days after start, only 30% of tuition minus AUD 350. Withdrawal >28 days before start: 70% of tuition + material fees refunded (minus AUD 350); <28 days: 50% of tuition; ≤28 days after start: 30%; after that, no refund. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 350; ภายใน 28 วันหลังเริ่มเรียน คืนเพียง 30% ของค่าเล่าเรียนหัก AUD 350 ถอนตัว >28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 70% ของค่าเล่าเรียน + ค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียน (หัก AUD 350); <28 วัน: 50% ของค่าเล่าเรียน; ≤28 วันหลังเริ่มเรียน: 30%; หลังจากนั้นไม่คืนเงิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ phí hành chính AUD 350; trong vòng 28 ngày sau khi khai giảng, chỉ hoàn 30% học phí trừ AUD 350. Rút học >28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 70% học phí + phí tài liệu (trừ AUD 350); <28 ngày: 50% học phí; ≤28 ngày sau khi khai giảng: 30%; sau đó, không hoàn tiền. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还全部费用，扣除 AUD 350 行政费；开课后 28 天内，仅退还 30% 学费并扣除 AUD 350。开课前 >28 天退学：退还 70% 学费 + 教材费（扣除 AUD 350）；<28 天：学费的 50%；开课后 ≤28 天：30%；此后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：AUD 350の事務手数料を差し引いて全費用を返金。開始後28日までは、授業料の30%からAUD 350を差し引いた額のみ。開始の28日超前の取り下げ：授業料＋教材費の70%を返金（AUD 350を差し引き）。28日未満：授業料の50%。開始後28日以内：30%。それ以降は返金なし。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: AUD 350 행정비를 공제한 모든 비용 환불, 개강 후 28일까지는 수업료의 30%에서 AUD 350을 공제한 금액만 환불됩니다. 개강 28일 초과 전 철회 시: 수업료의 70% + 교재비 환불(AUD 350 공제), 28일 미만: 수업료의 50%, 개강 후 28일 이하: 30%, 그 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 350; រហូតដល់ 28 ថ្ងៃក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញត្រឹមតែ 30% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា ដកចេញ AUD 350។ ការដកខ្លួន >28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 70% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា + ថ្លៃសម្ភារៈ (ដកចេញ AUD 350); <28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា; ≤28 ថ្ងៃក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ 30%; ក្រោយពីនោះ៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Evolution Systems for Training and Development Pty Ltd t/a Evolution Hospitality Institute, CRICOS 02869G, RTO 91256
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, refund 100% dikurangi 5% (maks. AUD 500). Mundur sebelum mulai: refund 100%/70%/50%/25% tergantung berapa hari sebelum mulai (61+/30-60/16-29/≤15 hari), dikurangi biaya proses AUD 400; setelah mulai tidak ada refund untuk periode berjalan. Biaya pendaftaran AUD 250 tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start date: 100% of paid course fee less 5% (deduction not more than AUD 500). After course start date: refund = weekly tuition fee x weeks in default period (unused portion). Evidence/time limit: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: Days before course start (current study period paid / subsequent period paid), each less AUD 400 processing fee: 61+ days: 100% / 100%; 30-60 days: 70% / 100%; 16-29 days: 50% / 100%; 15 days or less: 25% / 100%.
items.withdraw_after_start: Current study period: 0% refund. Prepaid subsequent study period, by days before it starts: 61+ days 100%; 30-60 days 70%; 16-29 days 50%; 15 days or less 25%.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee AUD 250; processing fees AUD 400 each (withdrawal/cancellation, deferment/suspension, RPL/credit transfer); reassessment, repeat, reissue and other listed fees. Course fees not refundable if student breaches enrolment/visa conditions, gives false information or fails to provide documents requested by Home Affairs.
items.provider_default: Within 14 days Evolution offers an alternative course at its expense (student accepts in writing) or refunds unspent prepaid fees; otherwise the Tuition Protection Service (TPS) assists.
items.document: Fees, Charges & Refund Policy & Procedure (International Students) - Version 2024.2
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, 100% refund minus 5% (max. AUD 500). Withdrawal before start: 100%/70%/50%/25% refund depending on how many days before start (61+/30-60/16-29/≤15 days), minus an AUD 400 processing fee; no refund for the current period after start. The AUD 250 enrolment fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน คืน 100% หัก 5% (สูงสุด AUD 500) ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 100%/70%/50%/25% ขึ้นอยู่กับจำนวนวันก่อนเริ่มเรียน (61+/30-60/16-29/≤15 วัน) หักค่าดำเนินการ AUD 400; ไม่คืนเงินของช่วงเวลาปัจจุบันหลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 250 ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, hoàn 100% trừ 5% (tối đa AUD 500). Rút học trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100%/70%/50%/25% tùy theo số ngày trước khi khai giảng (61+/30-60/16-29/≤15 ngày), trừ phí xử lý AUD 400; không hoàn tiền cho kỳ hiện tại sau khi khai giảng. Phí ghi danh AUD 250 không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，100% 退款并扣除 5%（最高 AUD 500）。开课前退学：根据距开课的天数（61+/30-60/16-29/≤15 天）退还 100%/70%/50%/25%，并扣除 AUD 400 手续费；开课后当期不予退款。AUD 250 注册费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、5%（上限AUD 500）を差し引いて100%返金。開始前の取り下げ：開始の何日前か（61日以上/30〜60日/16〜29日/15日以内）に応じて100%/70%/50%/25%を返金し、AUD 400の処理手数料を差し引き。開始後は当該期間の返金はありません。AUD 250の入学金は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 5%(최대 AUD 500)를 공제한 후 100% 환불됩니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 개강 며칠 전인지(61일 이상/30-60일/16-29일/15일 이하)에 따라 100%/70%/50%/25% 환불되며, AUD 400 처리 수수료가 공제됩니다. 개강 후에는 현재 기간에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. AUD 250 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន សងវិញ 100% ដកចេញ 5% (អតិបរមា AUD 500)។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 100%/70%/50%/25% អាស្រ័យលើចំនួនថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន (61+/30-60/16-29/≤15 ថ្ងៃ) ដកចេញថ្លៃដំណើរការ AUD 400; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់រយៈពេលបច្ចុប្បន្នក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 250 មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Federation Academy Australia Pty Ltd t/a Federation Academy (RTO 52785)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: biaya dikembalikan dikurangi application fee AUD 500, wajib bukti penolakan visa. Mundur >28 hari sebelum mulai refund semua biaya dikurangi AUD 500, <28 hari 50% biaya kursus dikurangi AUD 500, setelah mulai tidak ada refund; application fee AUD 500 tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before commencement: course fees paid minus AUD 500 application fee; requires Refund Request and proof of visa refusal. After commencement: unspent tuition (weekly tuition x weeks remaining in paid portion after default day). Visa removal for breach: nil.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice. More than 28 days before commencement: all fees minus non-refundable AUD 500 application fee. Less than 28 days: 50% of course fee minus AUD 500 application fee.
items.withdraw_after_start: Nil - no refund of paid tuition fees. Special circumstances (death/severe illness in immediate family): 100% of unspent fees.
items.non_refundable: AUD 500 application fee.
items.provider_default: Before commencement all fees refunded; after commencement unspent tuition refunded; student may choose refund within 14 days or alternative course (document also states 28 business days).
items.document: Student Handbook - Payment of Fees and Refund Policy and Procedure - Version 2025.3 (as printed; file name V2025.2-3)
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: fees refunded minus the AUD 500 application fee; proof of visa refusal required. Withdrawal >28 days before start: all fees refunded minus AUD 500; <28 days: 50% of course fees minus AUD 500; no refund after start; the AUD 500 application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนหักค่าสมัคร AUD 500; ต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัว >28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหัก AUD 500; <28 วัน: 50% ของค่าหลักสูตรหัก AUD 500; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร AUD 500 ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
