items.official_name: Magill College Pty Ltd (trading as Magill College Sydney)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Magill College mengembalikan biaya yang sudah dibayar dikurangi 5% atau A$500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Pemberitahuan tertulis lebih dari 28 hari sebelum mulai mendapat 75% biaya kuliah, kurang dari 28 hari 50%, dan setelah mulai tidak ada refund; enrolment fee A$200 tidak dapat dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused and student does not start or withdraws on/before start date: full prepaid fees minus the lesser of 5% of prepaid fees or A$500 (written proof required). Refused after start: pro-rata refund of unused tuition from the default date to the end of the paid period. ART appeal after onshore refusal affirmed, or student withdraws: Student Default rules apply.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice more than 28 days before start: 75% of tuition fees. Less than 28 days: 50% of tuition fees.
items.withdraw_after_start: Cancellation on or after the start date: no tuition refund.
items.non_refundable: A$200 enrolment fee; resources fee; accommodation placement and airport pick-up fees (visa refused after start); A$300 change-of-enrolment processing fee plus A$200 cancellation fee per CoE.
items.provider_default: Refund of unused tuition or a place in another College course at no extra cost (student chooses), within two weeks of the default day with a calculation statement; otherwise TPS assists.
items.document: VET and ELICOS Enrolment Form (refund conditions section) - Version 1.2; file uploaded June 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Magill College refunds fees paid minus 5% or A$500 (whichever is less). Written notice more than 28 days before start: 75% of tuition; less than 28 days: 50%; no refund after start; the A$200 enrolment fee is non-refundable. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Magill College จะคืนเงินที่ชำระแล้วหักออก 5% หรือ A$500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) แจ้งเป็นลายลักษณ์อักษรมากกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 75% ของค่าเล่าเรียน; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน A$200 ไม่สามารถขอคืนได้ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Magill College hoàn các khoản phí đã đóng sau khi trừ 5% hoặc A$500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Thông báo bằng văn bản hơn 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 75% học phí; dưới 28 ngày: 50%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí ghi danh A$200 không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Magill College 退还已付费用并扣除 5% 或 A$500（以较低者为准）。开课前超过 28 天书面通知：退还 75% 学费；不足 28 天：50%；开课后不予退款；A$200 注册费不可退。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Magill Collegeは支払った費用から5%またはA$500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金します。開始の28日超前に書面で通知した場合：授業料の75%。28日未満：50%。開始後の返金はありません。A$200の入学金は返金不可です。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Magill College는 납부한 비용에서 5% 또는 A$500(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제하고 환불합니다. 개강 28일 초과 전 서면 통지 시: 수업료의 75%, 28일 미만: 50%, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. A$200 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Magill College សងវិញនូវថ្លៃដែលបានបង់ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ A$500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការជូនដំណឹងជាលាយលក្ខណ៍អក្សរច្រើនជាង 28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 75% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន A$200 មិនអាចសងវិញបានទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: A2 Education Pty Ltd (trading as Matic International College)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Matic International College mengembalikan biaya yang dibayar dikurangi 5% atau $500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur lebih dari 4 minggu sebelum mulai mendapat refund 100% dikurangi $200 (2-4 minggu: 80% periode pertama), dan setelah mulai tidak ada refund untuk periode pembayaran berjalan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before start (misses agreed start date because of refusal): course fees paid minus the lower of 5% of fees received or $500; no refund if refusal is based on fraud, false information or unmet visa conditions; offshore students refused within 31 days after start who have not arrived/started may get a full refund. After start: weekly tuition fee x weeks remaining in the paid period.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 4 weeks before start: 100% of paid course fees less $200. 2-4 weeks: 80% of first payment period, 100% of later periods, less $200. 2 weeks or less: 0% of first payment period, 100% of later periods, less $200. Onshore students without a CoE: more than 4 weeks 40%; 4 weeks or less no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund for the current payment period (3 months); later paid periods refunded in full less $200 processing fee.
items.non_refundable: Handling, registration, application and administration fees; non-course fees (credit application, withdrawal processing, certificate re-issue, resubmission, placement, late and instalment fees, OSHC) - non-tuition fees refundable only for visa refusal before start. $200 withdrawal processing fee; overseas bank fee up to AUD 20.
items.provider_default: If the college cannot deliver the course in full: unspent prepaid fees refunded (weekly tuition x weeks from default day to end of paid period).
items.document: Refund Policy and Procedure - Version 2.0; date not stated (file uploaded September 2026)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Matic International College refunds fees paid minus 5% or $500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal more than 4 weeks before start: 100% refund minus $200 (2-4 weeks: 80% of the first period); no refund for the current payment period after start. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Matic International College จะคืนเงินที่ชำระแล้วหักออก 5% หรือ $500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวมากกว่า 4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 100% หัก $200 (2-4 สัปดาห์: 80% ของช่วงแรก); ไม่คืนเงินของงวดการชำระปัจจุบันหลังเริ่มเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Matic International College hoàn các khoản phí đã đóng sau khi trừ 5% hoặc $500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học hơn 4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100% trừ $200 (2-4 tuần: 80% của kỳ đầu tiên); không hoàn tiền cho kỳ thanh toán hiện tại sau khi khai giảng. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Matic International College 退还已付费用并扣除 5% 或 $500（以较低者为准）。开课前超过 4 周退学：100% 退款并扣除 $200（2-4 周：第一期的 80%）；开课后当前付款期不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Matic International Collegeは支払った費用から5%または$500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金します。開始の4週間超前の取り下げ：$200を差し引いて100%返金（2〜4週間前：最初の期間の80%）。開始後は当該支払期間の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Matic International College는 납부한 비용에서 5% 또는 $500(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제하고 환불합니다. 개강 4주 초과 전 철회 시: $200를 공제하고 100% 환불(2-4주: 첫 기간의 80%), 개강 후에는 현재 납부 기간에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Matic International College សងវិញនូវថ្លៃដែលបានបង់ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ $500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ 100% ដកចេញ $200 (2-4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 80% នៃរយៈពេលដំបូង); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់រយៈពេលបង់ប្រាក់បច្ចុប្បន្នក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: iLearn Oz Pty Ltd (trading as Melbourne Metro College)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Melbourne Metro College mengembalikan penuh biaya kuliah yang belum terpakai dikurangi application fee. Mundur sebelum mulai mendapat 85% (10 minggu atau lebih), 80% (7 minggu), 70% (4 minggu) atau 50% (kurang dari 4 minggu) dari biaya kuliah, dan setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before course start: full refund of unused prepaid tuition fees less the Application Fee. Visa extension refused (continuing students): same. Visa cancelled due to student's actions: no refund.
items.withdraw_before_start: Percent of total tuition fees: at least 10 weeks before start 85%; at least 7 weeks 80%; at least 4 weeks 70%; less than 4 weeks 50% (education agent fee may apply). Offer withdrawn for incorrect/fraudulent information: 50%; unable to meet enrolment conditions: 85%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund after the agreed start date (student default; college may claim outstanding fees).
items.non_refundable: Application Fee and all other fees and charges (amounts in Course Information Sheet/brochures/handbook).
items.provider_default: Written notice within 3 working days; within 10 working days offer of a suitable alternative course or full refund of unused prepaid tuition with a calculation statement; refund paid within 10 working days of the default; TPS applies.
items.document: Student Refund Policy (MMC_FP1) - Version 5.0, February 2025 (file uploaded June 2026)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Melbourne Metro College refunds unused tuition fees in full minus the application fee. Withdrawal before start: 85% (10 weeks or more), 80% (7 weeks), 70% (4 weeks) or 50% (less than 4 weeks) of tuition fees; no refund after start. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Melbourne Metro College จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ยังไม่ได้ใช้เต็มจำนวนหักค่าสมัคร ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 85% (10 สัปดาห์ขึ้นไป), 80% (7 สัปดาห์), 70% (4 สัปดาห์) หรือ 50% (น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์) ของค่าเล่าเรียน; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Melbourne Metro College hoàn toàn bộ học phí chưa sử dụng trừ phí nộp hồ sơ. Rút học trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 85% (từ 10 tuần trở lên), 80% (7 tuần), 70% (4 tuần) hoặc 50% (dưới 4 tuần) học phí; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Melbourne Metro College 全额退还未使用的学费，扣除申请费。开课前退学：退还学费的 85%（10 周或以上）、80%（7 周）、70%（4 周）或 50%（不足 4 周）；开课后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Melbourne Metro Collegeは出願料を差し引いて未使用の授業料を全額返金します。開始前の取り下げ：授業料の85%（10週間以上前）、80%（7週間前）、70%（4週間前）または50%（4週間未満）。開始後の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Melbourne Metro College는 미사용 수업료를 지원비를 공제하고 전액 환불합니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 수업료의 85%(10주 이상), 80%(7주), 70%(4주) 또는 50%(4주 미만) 환불, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Melbourne Metro College សងវិញទាំងស្រុងនូវថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលមិនទាន់បានប្រើ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 85% (10 សប្តាហ៍ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះ) 80% (7 សប្តាហ៍) 70% (4 សប្តាហ៍) ឬ 50% (តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍) នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, biaya dikembalikan penuh dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur sebelum mulai: ≥13 minggu 100%, 9–12 minggu 75%, 5–8 minggu 50%, ≤4 minggu 25% (semua dipotong biaya admin AUD 250); setelah mulai tidak ada refund kecuali keadaan khusus. Biaya admin AUD 250, akomodasi, dan airport pick-up tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused (not caused by student) before commencement: full refund of total fees paid minus the lower of 5% of total fees or AUD 500. Evidence: Department of Home Affairs correspondence. Excluded: refusal due to fraudulent documents or visa breach. General claim deadline 14 calendar days from the qualifying event.
items.withdraw_before_start: Notice before commencement (all minus AUD 250 admin fee): 13+ weeks - 100% of fees paid; 9-12 weeks - 75%; 5-8 weeks - 50%; 4 weeks or less - 25%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund, except special circumstances arising on/after commencement that make completion impracticable (pro-rata on training delivered, evidence required) or visa refusal.
items.non_refundable: AUD 250 administrative fee retained from pre-commencement refunds; accommodation placement and airport pick-up fees not refunded. No refund for standard withdrawal after start, cancellation for unsatisfactory progress, misconduct, non-payment, breach of Letter of Offer, fraudulent documents, or visa breach.
items.provider_default: Refund of unspent tuition within 14 days or alternative course placement within 14 days (student chooses); TPS assists if the Institute cannot.
items.document: MITP10 Refund Policy and Procedure - Quick Reference Guide (Menzies Institute of Technology, CRICOS 02815M, RTO 21834); full policy MITP10 Ver 31: https://menzies.vic.edu.au/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/MITP10-Refund-Policy-and-Procedure-Ver-31.pdf - Summary last updated November 2025; full policy Version 31, approved 09/08/2023
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, fees are refunded in full minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal before start: ≥13 weeks 100%, 9–12 weeks 75%, 5–8 weeks 50%, ≤4 weeks 25% (all minus an AUD 250 admin fee); no refund after start except in special circumstances. The AUD 250 admin fee, accommodation and airport pick-up are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าเรียนเต็มจำนวนหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: ≥13 สัปดาห์ 100%, 9–12 สัปดาห์ 75%, 5–8 สัปดาห์ 50%, ≤4 สัปดาห์ 25% (ทั้งหมดหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 250); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ยกเว้นกรณีพิเศษ ไม่คืนค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 250 ค่าที่พัก และค่าบริการรับที่สนามบิน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, các khoản phí được hoàn đầy đủ sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học trước khi khai giảng: ≥13 tuần 100%, 9–12 tuần 75%, 5–8 tuần 50%, ≤4 tuần 25% (tất cả đều trừ phí hành chính AUD 250); không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng trừ trường hợp đặc biệt. Phí hành chính AUD 250, chỗ ở và đón sân bay không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，全额退还费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前退学：≥13 周 100%，9–12 周 75%，5–8 周 50%，≤4 周 25%（均扣除 AUD 250 行政费）；开课后不予退款，特殊情况除外。AUD 250 行政费、住宿费和接机费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて全額返金されます。開始前の取り下げ：13週間以上前は100%、9〜12週間前は75%、5〜8週間前は50%、4週間以内は25%（いずれもAUD 250の事務手数料を差し引き）。開始後は特別な事情がある場合を除き返金はありません。AUD 250の事務手数料、宿泊費、空港送迎は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 전액 환불됩니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 13주 이상 100%, 9–12주 75%, 5–8주 50%, 4주 이하 25%(모두 AUD 250 행정비 공제), 개강 후에는 특별한 사유를 제외하고 환불되지 않습니다. AUD 250 행정비, 숙소비, 공항 픽업 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃត្រូវបានសងវិញទាំងស្រុង ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ≥13 សប្តាហ៍ 100%, 9–12 សប្តាហ៍ 75%, 5–8 សប្តាហ៍ 50%, ≤4 សប្តាហ៍ 25% (ទាំងអស់ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 250); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ លើកលែងតែក្នុងកាលៈទេសៈពិសេស។ ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 250 ថ្លៃកន្លែងស្នាក់នៅ និងសេវាទទួលពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai (dengan bukti), semua biaya dikembalikan kecuali enrolment fee; jika ditolak setelah mulai, dikurangi tuition yang sudah terpakai. Mundur lebih dari 4 minggu (28 hari) sebelum mulai refund penuh dikurangi enrolment fee, kurang dari 28 hari refund 50%; setelah mulai tidak ada refund; enrolment fee (AUD 250) tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before commencement: all fees refunded in full except enrolment fees; documentary evidence of visa refusal must accompany the request; paid within 10 working days after written advice received. Visa refused after commencement: same, except no refund for tuition already used (pro rata by week or part thereof).
items.withdraw_before_start: (Visa granted or no visa application lodged) More than 4 weeks (28 calendar days) before course start: total fees paid less enrolment fee refunded. Up to 28 calendar days before start: 50% of total fees paid refunded, less non-refundable enrolment fee.
items.withdraw_after_start: Once study has commenced (visa not refused): no refund for the relevant study period if the student withdraws or defaults (including cancellation by the college for student default). Compassionate/compelling circumstances may be reviewed with evidence.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (handbook lists AUD 250 enrolment fee); application fees where applicable. No refund for late commencement.
items.provider_default: Provider default (course not starting on agreed day, ceasing before completion, or not provided in full): total course money received refunded in AUD within 10 working days after the default date (bank details may be required within 5 working days); statement of calculation provided. If the college cancels/withdraws a course for any reason, full refund of tuition fees. TPS applies.
items.document: International and Domestic Student Handbook – Refund Policy & Procedures (Mid City Education Pty Ltd T/A Mid City College) - V 3.0 January 2025
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start (with proof), all fees are refunded except the enrolment fee; if refused after start, tuition already used is deducted. Withdrawal more than 4 weeks (28 days) before start: full refund minus the enrolment fee; less than 28 days: 50% refund; no refund after start; the enrolment fee (AUD 250) is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน (มีหลักฐาน) จะคืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดยกเว้นค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน; หากถูกปฏิเสธหลังเริ่มเรียน จะหักค่าเล่าเรียนส่วนที่ใช้ไปแล้ว ถอนตัวมากกว่า 4 สัปดาห์ (28 วัน) ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวนหักค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน; น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: คืน 50%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน (AUD 250) ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng (có bằng chứng), toàn bộ các khoản phí được hoàn trừ phí ghi danh; nếu bị từ chối sau khi khai giảng, phần học phí đã sử dụng sẽ bị khấu trừ. Rút học hơn 4 tuần (28 ngày) trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ trừ phí ghi danh; dưới 28 ngày: hoàn 50%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí ghi danh (AUD 250) không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒（需提供证明），退还除注册费外的全部费用；如开课后被拒，扣除已使用的学费。开课前超过 4 周（28 天）退学：全额退款并扣除注册费；不足 28 天：退还 50%；开课后不予退款；注册费（AUD 250）不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合（証明あり）、入学金を除く全費用が返金されます。開始後に却下された場合は、すでに使用した授業料が差し引かれます。開始の4週間（28日）超前の取り下げ：入学金を差し引いて全額返金。28日未満：50%返金。開始後の返金はありません。入学金（AUD 250）は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우(증빙 제출 시), 입학금을 제외한 모든 비용이 환불되며, 개강 후 거절된 경우에는 이미 사용한 수업료가 공제됩니다. 개강 4주(28일) 초과 전 철회 시: 입학금을 공제하고 전액 환불, 28일 미만: 50% 환불, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금(AUD 250)은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន (មានភស្តុតាង) ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ លើកលែងតែថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន; ប្រសិនបើត្រូវបានបដិសេធក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលបានប្រើរួចហើយត្រូវបានកាត់ចេញ។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍ (28 ថ្ងៃ) មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង ដកចេញថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ សងវិញ 50%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន (AUD 250) មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Million Brown's College (legal entity not stated separately)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Million Brown's College mengembalikan biaya kuliah untuk pelatihan yang belum diberikan dikurangi application fee $200. Mundur minimal 10 minggu sebelum mulai mendapat 100% biaya kuliah, 4-10 minggu 70%, kurang dari 4 minggu 25%, dan setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before start: assessed under the written agreement and ESOS; standard position is refund of tuition paid for undelivered training less the non-refundable application fee, unless legislation requires more. After start (extension refused): assessed under the written agreement, ESOS and tuition already delivered.
items.withdraw_before_start: Tuition fees paid, less $200 application fee: at least 10 weeks before start 100%; more than 4 and less than 10 weeks 70%; less than 4 weeks 25%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund unless required by law, approved as an exception, or compassionate/compelling circumstances; abandoning during the current semester - no tuition refund and outstanding semester fees remain payable.
items.non_refundable: $200 application fee (unless MBC cancels before commencement or agreement says otherwise); non-tuition fees once service provided (e.g. deferment $100, change of CoE $100, unit repeat $350/unit, certificate reissue $50, airport pickup $100, late payment $50/week); RPL $150/unit once assessment commenced.
items.provider_default: Course not started: 100% of tuition paid; withdrawn by MBC before start: full refund of all fees including application fee. Unable to deliver after commencement: unused tuition refunded or alternative enrolment by agreement, within the provider obligation period (ESOS/TPS).
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy and Procedure (MBC-FEE-001) - Version 2.0, approved 18 March 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Million Brown's College refunds tuition for training not yet delivered minus the $200 application fee. Withdrawal at least 10 weeks before start: 100% of tuition; 4-10 weeks: 70%; less than 4 weeks: 25%; no refund after start. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Million Brown's College จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนสำหรับการฝึกอบรมที่ยังไม่ได้จัดให้ หักค่าสมัคร $200 ถอนตัวอย่างน้อย 10 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 100% ของค่าเล่าเรียน; 4-10 สัปดาห์: 70%; น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์: 25%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Million Brown's College hoàn học phí cho phần đào tạo chưa được giảng dạy, trừ phí nộp hồ sơ $200. Rút học ít nhất 10 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 100% học phí; 4-10 tuần: 70%; dưới 4 tuần: 25%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Million Brown's College 退还尚未开展培训部分的学费，扣除 $200 申请费。开课前至少 10 周退学：退还 100% 学费；4-10 周：70%；不足 4 周：25%；开课后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Million Brown's Collegeは未実施の研修分の授業料から$200の出願料を差し引いて返金します。開始の少なくとも10週間前の取り下げ：授業料の100%。4〜10週間前：70%。4週間未満：25%。開始後の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Million Brown's College는 아직 제공되지 않은 교육에 대한 수업료를 $200 지원비를 공제하고 환불합니다. 개강 최소 10주 전 철회 시: 수업료의 100%, 4-10주: 70%, 4주 미만: 25%, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Million Brown's College សងវិញនូវថ្លៃសិក្សាសម្រាប់ការបណ្តុះបណ្តាលដែលមិនទាន់បានផ្តល់ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ $200។ ការដកខ្លួនយ៉ាងហោចណាស់ 10 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 100% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សា; 4-10 សប្តាហ៍៖ 70%; តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 25%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Million Brown's College (MBC)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: tuition dikembalikan dikurangi application fee AUD 200. Mundur ≥10 minggu sebelum mulai refund penuh, 4–10 minggu 70%, <4 minggu 25% (dikurangi AUD 200), setelah mulai tidak ada refund; application fee dan biaya non-tuition yang sudah dipakai tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: tuition fees paid for undelivered training refunded less the non-refundable application fee of $200, unless legislation requires a higher amount; assessed under the written agreement and ESOS. Visa refusal notice as evidence. After start (visa extension refused): assessed under written agreement/ESOS, no fixed amount stated. Time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: At least 10 weeks before start: full refund of tuition fees paid; more than 4 and less than 10 weeks: 70%; less than 4 weeks: 25% (each less the $200 application fee).
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund unless required by law, approved as an exception, or compassionate/compelling circumstances.
items.non_refundable: Application fee $200 (unless MBC cancels the course or written agreement states otherwise); non-tuition fees (materials, reissue, deferment, airport pickup, late payment) once service provided; RPL fees $150 per unit once assessment started; current study period tuition if student abandons course; cancellations for misconduct.
items.provider_default: Placement in suitable alternative course or refund of unspent tuition within legally required period; if not commenced, 100% of tuition refunded; if course withdrawn before start, all fees including application fee refunded.
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy and Procedure (MBC-FEE-001) - Version 2.0, approved 18 March 2026
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: tuition refunded minus the AUD 200 application fee. Withdrawal ≥10 weeks before start: full refund; 4–10 weeks: 70%; <4 weeks: 25% (minus AUD 200); no refund after start; the application fee and non-tuition fees already used are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักค่าสมัคร AUD 200 ถอนตัว ≥10 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวน; 4–10 สัปดาห์: 70%; <4 สัปดาห์: 25% (หัก AUD 200); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัครและค่าใช้จ่ายที่ไม่ใช่ค่าเล่าเรียนที่ใช้ไปแล้ว ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn học phí trừ phí nộp hồ sơ AUD 200. Rút học ≥10 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ; 4–10 tuần: 70%; <4 tuần: 25% (trừ AUD 200); không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng; phí nộp hồ sơ và các khoản phí ngoài học phí đã sử dụng không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还学费并扣除 AUD 200 申请费。开课前 ≥10 周退学：全额退款；4–10 周：70%；<4 周：25%（扣除 AUD 200）；开课后不予退款；申请费及已使用的非学费费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：授業料からAUD 200の出願料を差し引いて返金。開始の10週間以上前の取り下げ：全額返金。4〜10週間前：70%。4週間未満：25%（AUD 200を差し引き）。開始後の返金はありません。出願料と使用済みの授業料以外の費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 수업료에서 AUD 200 지원비를 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 10주 이상 전 철회 시: 전액 환불, 4–10주: 70%, 4주 미만: 25%(AUD 200 공제), 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비와 이미 사용한 수업료 외 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ AUD 200។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥10 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង; 4–10 សប្តាហ៍៖ 70%; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 25% (ដកចេញ AUD 200); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ និងថ្លៃមិនមែនថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលបានប្រើរួចហើយ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: National Academy of Professional Studies (NAPS), Sydney (Surry Hills) and Melbourne; CRICOS code not stated in document
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, biaya yang dibayar dikembalikan dikurangi AUD 500 (wajib surat penolakan dari Home Affairs, diajukan ≥3 minggu sebelum term). Mundur >10 minggu sebelum mulai: refund dikurangi AUD 500; 4-10 minggu: sekitar 50%; <4 minggu: sekitar 20%, dikurangi enrolment AUD 250 dan admin AUD 750; setelah census date tidak ada refund. Komisi agen juga dipotong dari refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: If visa cannot be obtained from an Australian Diplomatic Office (not due to student default/breach): course fees paid minus AUD 500. Evidence: certified copy of Department of Home Affairs refusal letter with SS015F Refund Request Form. Must be lodged at least 3 weeks before the start of the term of the offer. If visa expires after enrolment and a later application is refused: first 6 months' fees non-refundable; later trimesters refunded pro-rata minus AUD 250 enrolment fee and AUD 750 admin fee.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 10 weeks before term start: fees paid minus AUD 500. Less than 10 but more than 4 weeks: 50% of fees (one trimester paid) or 50% of first trimester + 80% of later trimesters, minus AUD 250 enrolment fee and AUD 750 admin fee. Less than 4 weeks before term start but before census date: 20% (one trimester) or 20% of first + 50% of later trimesters, minus AUD 250 and AUD 750.
items.withdraw_after_start: Withdrawal after the census date (no earlier than 20% through a unit): no refund. Illness/compassionate cases considered individually under Special Consideration.
items.non_refundable: AUD 250 enrolment fee and AUD 750 administration fee (deducted as above); amounts paid to a recruitment representative are deducted from refunds; no refund for false information, termination for breach/non-attendance/non-payment, or deferred enrolment not commenced. Third-party fees refunded by the third party.
items.provider_default: If NAPS cannot provide the course: full refund of course fee paid, or alternative place at no extra cost; if NAPS closes, Tuition Protection Service assists.
items.document: NAPS SS005 International Student Fee Refund Policy - Version 4.0, approved 12 May 2025 (effective 1 November 2022)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, fees paid are refunded minus AUD 500 (Home Affairs refusal letter required, submitted ≥3 weeks before the term). Withdrawal >10 weeks before start: refund minus AUD 500; 4-10 weeks: about 50%; <4 weeks: about 20%, minus an AUD 250 enrolment fee and AUD 750 admin fee; no refund after the census date. Agent commission is also deducted from the refund. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนเงินที่ชำระแล้วหัก AUD 500 (ต้องมีจดหมายปฏิเสธจาก Home Affairs ยื่น ≥3 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเทอม) ถอนตัว >10 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเงินหัก AUD 500; 4-10 สัปดาห์: ประมาณ 50%; <4 สัปดาห์: ประมาณ 20% หักค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 250 และค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ AUD 750; ไม่คืนเงินหลัง census date ค่าคอมมิชชันเอเจนต์จะถูกหักออกจากเงินคืนด้วย ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, các khoản phí đã đóng được hoàn sau khi trừ AUD 500 (cần thư từ chối của Home Affairs, nộp ≥3 tuần trước kỳ học). Rút học >10 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn tiền trừ AUD 500; 4-10 tuần: khoảng 50%; <4 tuần: khoảng 20%, trừ phí ghi danh AUD 250 và phí hành chính AUD 750; không hoàn tiền sau census date. Hoa hồng đại lý cũng bị khấu trừ khỏi khoản hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，退还已付费用并扣除 AUD 500（需提供 Home Affairs 拒签信，并在学期开始前 ≥3 周提交）。开课前 >10 周退学：退款扣除 AUD 500；4-10 周：约 50%；<4 周：约 20%，并扣除 AUD 250 注册费和 AUD 750 行政费；census date 之后不予退款。中介佣金也会从退款中扣除。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、支払った費用からAUD 500を差し引いて返金されます（Home Affairsの却下通知書が必要で、学期開始の3週間以上前に提出）。開始の10週間超前の取り下げ：AUD 500を差し引いて返金。4〜10週間前：約50%。4週間未満：約20%で、AUD 250の入学金とAUD 750の事務手数料を差し引き。census date 以降の返金はありません。エージェント手数料も返金額から差し引かれます。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 납부한 비용에서 AUD 500을 공제한 후 환불됩니다(Home Affairs 거절 서신 필요, 학기 시작 3주 이상 전에 제출). 개강 10주 초과 전 철회 시: AUD 500 공제 후 환불, 4-10주: 약 50%, 4주 미만: 약 20%(AUD 250 입학금과 AUD 750 행정비 공제), census date 이후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 에이전트 커미션도 환불액에서 공제됩니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃដែលបានបង់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ AUD 500 (ត្រូវមានលិខិតបដិសេធពី Home Affairs ដែលដាក់ជូន ≥3 សប្តាហ៍មុនឆមាស)។ ការដកខ្លួន >10 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញ ដកចេញ AUD 500; 4-10 សប្តាហ៍៖ ប្រហែល 50%; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ ប្រហែល 20% ដកចេញថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 250 និងថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល AUD 750; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយថ្ងៃ census date ទេ។ កម្រៃជើងសារភ្នាក់ងារក៏ត្រូវកាត់ចេញពីប្រាក់សងវិញដែរ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: New Cambridge College Sydney Inc. (NCCS)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, NCCS mengembalikan biaya kuliah dikurangi 5% atau $500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur 28 hari atau lebih sebelum mulai mendapat refund biaya kuliah dikurangi biaya admin $500; kurang dari 28 hari atau setelah kursus dimulai tidak ada refund, dan enrolment fee tidak dapat dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Refused before start: all tuition received refunded minus the lesser of 5% of total course fees received or $500; material fees also refunded; within 28 days of evidence and completed form. No refund if refused for fraud/false information. Refused or cancelled after start: unused tuition refunded (tuition paid minus portion delivered); material fees non-refundable.
items.withdraw_before_start: Form and evidence 28+ days before start: all tuition refunded minus $500 administration fee. Less than 28 days before start: no tuition refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund after commencement (also no refund if the student withdraws an AAT appeal and cancels enrolment).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (always); material, CoE reissue and credit-transfer application fees (except where the visa is cancelled/refused before start).
items.provider_default: Course not starting on the designated day or cancelled after starting: full refund of all course fees if alternative arrangements move the start more than 14 days; after start, unused tuition for the undelivered portion refunded (ESOS 2024 Instrument). Paid within 14 days; TPS assists if needed.
items.document: Fee Refund Policy - Version not stated; latest change 05/12/2025 (file uploaded March 2026)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, NCCS refunds tuition fees minus 5% or $500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal 28 days or more before start: tuition refunded minus a $500 admin fee; less than 28 days or after the course starts: no refund; the enrolment fee is non-refundable. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน NCCS จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักออก 5% หรือ $500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัว 28 วันขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ $500; น้อยกว่า 28 วันหรือหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร: ไม่คืนเงิน; ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียนไม่สามารถขอคืนได้ ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, NCCS hoàn học phí sau khi trừ 5% hoặc $500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học từ 28 ngày trở lên trước khi khai giảng: hoàn học phí trừ phí hành chính $500; dưới 28 ngày hoặc sau khi khóa học bắt đầu: không hoàn tiền; phí ghi danh không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，NCCS 退还学费并扣除 5% 或 $500（以较低者为准）。开课前 28 天或以上退学：退还学费并扣除 $500 行政费；不足 28 天或课程开始后：不予退款；注册费不可退。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、NCCSは授業料から5%または$500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金します。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：授業料から$500の事務手数料を差し引いて返金。28日未満またはコース開始後：返金なし。入学金は返金不可です。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, NCCS는 수업료에서 5% 또는 $500(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제하고 환불합니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료에서 $500 행정비를 공제하고 환불, 28일 미만 또는 코스 시작 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន NCCS សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ $500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួន 28 ថ្ងៃ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល $500; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ ឬក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើម៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនអាចសងវិញបានទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: New Era Institute Pty Ltd (NEI), CRICOS 03509B, RTO 41543, 100 George Street Windsor NSW
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, uang kuliah dikembalikan 100% kecuali biaya pendaftaran dan biaya CoE (wajib bukti penolakan visa). Mundur sebelum mulai: refund penuh jika >28 hari sebelumnya, 50% jika ≤28 hari, 25% jika 5-10 hari kerja, dan tidak ada refund jika <5 hari kerja; setelah mulai tidak ada refund kecuali keadaan darurat/compassionate. Biaya pendaftaran, CoE dan resource fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: 100% of tuition fees refunded, excluding enrolment fee and CoE issuing fee. Evidence: proof of refusal from the Australian visa office. Paid within 28 days of receiving the visa refusal letter. (Handbook: all fees forfeited if refusal due to fraudulent/forged documents or misleading information.)
items.withdraw_before_start: With written notice: more than 28 days before commencement: full refund of prepaid course fees excluding enrolment and CoE fees; 28 days or less: 50% refund; 5-10 business days before: 25% refund (75% forfeited); less than 5 business days: no refund except extenuating/compassionate circumstances. Paid within 28 days of written notice and refund request.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of prepaid fees unless verifiable extenuating or compassionate circumstances (e.g. bereavement, natural disaster, illness, caring obligations, accident); then refund calculated as weekly tuition fee x remaining prepaid weeks, excluding enrolment, CoE and resource fees.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee; CoE issuing fee; non-refundable resource fees (amounts not stated in the policy; see NEI fees page).
items.provider_default: NEI notifies students within 3 business days; offers alternative course within 14 days or refunds within 14 days (100% of tuition if not yet commenced; unspent portion if commenced). If NEI cannot, TPS places the student.
items.document: Fees and Refunds Policy (Overseas Students) - 2026 V1.0
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, tuition is refunded 100% except the enrolment fee and CoE fee (proof of visa refusal required). Withdrawal before start: full refund if >28 days before; 50% if ≤28 days; 25% if 5-10 working days; no refund if <5 working days; no refund after start except in emergency/compassionate circumstances. Enrolment fee, CoE fee and resource fee are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียน 100% ยกเว้นค่าลงทะเบียนเรียนและค่า CoE (ต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า) ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวนหาก >28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน; 50% หาก ≤28 วัน; 25% หาก 5-10 วันทำการ; ไม่คืนเงินหาก <5 วันทำการ; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ยกเว้นกรณีฉุกเฉิน/เหตุจำเป็นอันน่าเห็นใจ ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ค่า CoE และค่าทรัพยากรการเรียน (resource fee) ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, học phí được hoàn 100% trừ phí ghi danh và phí CoE (cần có bằng chứng bị từ chối visa). Rút học trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ nếu >28 ngày trước; 50% nếu ≤28 ngày; 25% nếu 5-10 ngày làm việc; không hoàn tiền nếu <5 ngày làm việc; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng trừ trường hợp khẩn cấp/lý do nhân đạo. Phí ghi danh, phí CoE và phí học liệu không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，100% 退还学费，注册费和 CoE 费除外（需提供拒签证明）。开课前退学：提前 >28 天全额退款；≤28 天退还 50%；5-10 个工作日退还 25%；<5 个工作日不予退款；开课后不予退款，紧急/恩恤情况除外。注册费、CoE 费和资料费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、入学金とCoE費用を除き授業料が100%返金されます（ビザ却下の証明が必要）。開始前の取り下げ：28日超前なら全額返金。28日以内なら50%。5〜10営業日前なら25%。5営業日未満なら返金なし。開始後は緊急時/やむを得ない事情（compassionate circumstances）の場合を除き返金なし。入学金、CoE費用、リソース費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 입학금과 CoE 비용을 제외한 수업료가 100% 환불됩니다(비자 거절 증빙 필요). 개강 전 철회 시: 28일 초과 전이면 전액 환불, 28일 이하이면 50%, 영업일 기준 5-10일이면 25%, 영업일 기준 5일 미만이면 환불되지 않으며, 개강 후에는 긴급/인도적 사유를 제외하고 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금, CoE 비용, 자료비(resource fee)는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ 100% លើកលែងតែថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន និងថ្លៃ CoE (ត្រូវមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ)។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង ប្រសិនបើ >28 ថ្ងៃមុន; 50% ប្រសិនបើ ≤28 ថ្ងៃ; 25% ប្រសិនបើ 5-10 ថ្ងៃធ្វើការ; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ ប្រសិនបើ <5 ថ្ងៃធ្វើការ; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ លើកលែងតែក្នុងកាលៈទេសៈបន្ទាន់/មនុស្សធម៌។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន ថ្លៃ CoE និងថ្លៃធនធានសិក្សា មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Novus Education Pty Ltd (trading as Novus College)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, Novus College memotong 5% total biaya atau $500 (mana yang lebih kecil) dan mengembalikan sisanya; mundur 4 minggu atau lebih sebelum mulai mendapat refund semua biaya kecuali application fee (kurang dari 4 minggu: 90%). Mundur setelah kursus dimulai tidak ada refund untuk term berjalan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before start (or withdrawal on/before start because of refusal), or refused after start: College retains the lower of 5% of total fees or $500 and refunds the balance.
items.withdraw_before_start: 4 weeks or more before start: all fees except the application fee refunded. Less than 4 weeks before start: 90% of fees other than the application fee refunded. Not starting on the agreed date without prior withdrawal: no refund; full study-period (term) fees payable.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund; fees for the full study period (term) are payable.
items.non_refundable: Application fee (unless the College cancels the course before it starts).
items.provider_default: College cancels before start: full refund of all fees. After start, or no compliant written agreement: refund of unspent fees (weekly tuition x weeks remaining from date of default). Paid automatically within 10 working days.
items.document: International Student Handbook - Version not stated; file uploaded November 2023
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, Novus College deducts 5% of total fees or $500 (whichever is less) and refunds the rest; withdrawal 4 weeks or more before start: all fees refunded except the application fee (less than 4 weeks: 90%). Withdrawal after the course starts: no refund for the current term. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ Novus College จะหัก 5% ของค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหรือ $500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) และคืนส่วนที่เหลือ; ถอนตัว 4 สัปดาห์ขึ้นไปก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดยกเว้นค่าสมัคร (น้อยกว่า 4 สัปดาห์: 90%) ถอนตัวหลังเริ่มหลักสูตร: ไม่คืนเงินของเทอมปัจจุบัน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, Novus College khấu trừ 5% tổng các khoản phí hoặc $500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn) và hoàn phần còn lại; rút học từ 4 tuần trở lên trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ phí nộp hồ sơ (dưới 4 tuần: 90%). Rút học sau khi khóa học bắt đầu: không hoàn tiền cho kỳ hiện tại. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，Novus College 扣除总费用的 5% 或 $500（以较低者为准）后退还其余部分；开课前 4 周或以上退学：退还除申请费外的全部费用（不足 4 周：90%）。课程开始后退学：当前学期不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、Novus Collegeは費用総額の5%または$500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて残額を返金します。開始の4週間以上前の取り下げ：出願料を除く全費用を返金（4週間未満：90%）。コース開始後の取り下げ：当該学期の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, Novus College는 총 비용의 5% 또는 $500(둘 중 적은 금액)를 공제하고 나머지를 환불합니다. 개강 4주 이상 전 철회 시: 지원비를 제외한 모든 비용 환불(4주 미만: 90%). 코스 시작 후 철회 시: 현재 학기에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ Novus College កាត់ 5% នៃថ្លៃសរុប ឬ $500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ហើយសងវិញនូវចំនួនដែលនៅសល់; ការដកខ្លួន 4 សប្តាហ៍ ឬច្រើនជាងនេះមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ លើកលែងតែថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ (តិចជាង 4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 90%)។ ការដកខ្លួនក្រោយពេលវគ្គសិក្សាចាប់ផ្តើម៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់ឆមាសបច្ចុប្បន្នទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, biaya dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil), dengan bukti penolakan visa. Mundur ≥8 minggu sebelum mulai: refund penuh, 4–8 minggu: 60%, <4 minggu atau setelah mulai: tidak ada refund. Application/enrolment fee AUD 300 dan beberapa biaya lain (airport pickup, PPE, dll.) tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa refused before commencement: refund of course fees received (tuition plus non-tuition) minus the lower of 5% of fees received or AUD 500. After commencement: weekly provider-default calculation. No refund if refusal due to misleading/fraudulent information. Evidence: Refund Request Form and proof of visa refusal. Time limit not stated. OSHC arranged via NTCA refunded subject to insurer terms.
items.withdraw_before_start: 8 or more weeks before commencement: full course fee (tuition plus non-tuition). Less than 8 but more than 4 weeks: 60% of course fee received. Less than 4 weeks: no refund. Requires DSW (withdrawal) form and Refund Form.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund.
items.non_refundable: Application/Enrolment fee AUD 300; English placement test AUD 20; PPE/toolkit once issued; RPL fee; reassessment AUD 300/unit; re-enrolment AUD 500/unit; CoE change admin AUD 300; airport pickup AUD 100; ID reissue AUD 50; replacement certificate AUD 50; late payment AUD 50/fortnight; card/bank surcharges. Materials fee AUD 500-1,000 refundable pro rata.
items.provider_default: Student chooses a suitable alternative course at no extra cost or refund of all unused tuition (weekly tuition x weeks in default, per ESOS Refund Instrument 2024), paid within 14 days of the default day.
items.document: Fees, Charges and Refunds Policy & Procedures - National Training Centre of Australia Pty Ltd t/a National Training College of Australia (CRICOS 03399C, RTO 6527) - Version 1.4 (next review 04 Nov 2027; issue date not stated)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, fees are refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less), with proof of visa refusal. Withdrawal ≥8 weeks before start: full refund; 4–8 weeks: 60%; <4 weeks or after start: no refund. The AUD 300 application/enrolment fee and some other fees (airport pickup, PPE, etc.) are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าเรียนหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) โดยต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัว ≥8 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวน; 4–8 สัปดาห์: 60%; <4 สัปดาห์หรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร/ค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน AUD 300 และค่าใช้จ่ายอื่นบางรายการ (ค่าบริการรับที่สนามบิน, PPE ฯลฯ) ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, các khoản phí được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn), kèm bằng chứng bị từ chối visa. Rút học ≥8 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ; 4–8 tuần: 60%; <4 tuần hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền. Phí nộp hồ sơ/ghi danh AUD 300 và một số khoản phí khác (đón sân bay, PPE, v.v.) không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，凭拒签证明退还费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前 ≥8 周退学：全额退款；4–8 周：60%；<4 周或开课后：不予退款。AUD 300 申请/注册费及部分其他费用（接机、PPE 等）不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、ビザ却下の証明があれば、費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始の8週間以上前の取り下げ：全額返金。4〜8週間前：60%。4週間未満または開始後：返金なし。AUD 300の出願料/入学金と、その他一部の費用（空港送迎、PPEなど）は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 비자 거절 증빙을 제출하면 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 8주 이상 전 철회 시: 전액 환불, 4–8주: 60%, 4주 미만 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. AUD 300 지원비/입학금과 일부 기타 비용(공항 픽업, PPE 등)은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ដោយមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥8 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង; 4–8 សប្តាហ៍៖ 60%; <4 សប្តាហ៍ ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ/ចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន AUD 300 និងថ្លៃមួយចំនួនទៀត (សេវាទទួលពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ PPE ជាដើម) មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, biaya dikembalikan penuh dikurangi biaya administrasi refund (dengan surat penolakan visa, diajukan minimal 2 minggu sebelum term mulai). Mundur >10 minggu sebelum term: refund penuh, 6–10 minggu: 70%, 2–6 minggu: 50%, <2 minggu: 30%; setelah mulai tidak ada refund untuk term tersebut. Application fee tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Total refund if the applicant cannot obtain a visa; a refund administration fee is deducted from any approved refund (amount not stated). Evidence: certified copy of the official visa rejection letter. Lodge at least 2 weeks before term starts. Visa expiring after start and later refused: pro-rata weekly refund less deductions.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 10 weeks before term: full refund. 6-10 weeks: 70% of that term's tuition. 2-6 weeks: 50%. Less than 2 weeks: 30%. Administrative fees and deductions apply to partial refunds.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of that term's fees; illness/compassionate grounds assessed case by case; no refund where more than 50% of course completed.
items.non_refundable: Application fee. No refund for false/misleading information, termination for rule/visa breaches, non-attendance or unsatisfactory progress; no refund of tuition paid for the first six months of the principal course (transfer context); requests due to job loss, moving interstate etc. not accepted.
items.provider_default: If NTA cannot offer or continue a course, a refund is offered after discussion with the student; payment within max 4 weeks (20 working days) of the refund letter. Alternative arrangement or refund if a third party cannot deliver.
items.document: Fees, Payments and Refunds (International Students) - Care Plus Training Pty Ltd T/A Nurse Training Australia (RTO 41009, CRICOS 03575C) - v3 (code 012018); NTA policy page marks it 'Currently under review'
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, fees are refunded in full minus a refund administration fee (with the visa refusal letter, submitted at least 2 weeks before the term starts). Withdrawal >10 weeks before the term: full refund; 6–10 weeks: 70%; 2–6 weeks: 50%; <2 weeks: 30%; no refund for that term after start. The application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนค่าเรียนเต็มจำนวนหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการคืนเงิน (พร้อมจดหมายปฏิเสธวีซ่า ยื่นอย่างน้อย 2 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเทอม) ถอนตัว >10 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเทอม: คืนเต็มจำนวน; 6–10 สัปดาห์: 70%; 2–6 สัปดาห์: 50%; <2 สัปดาห์: 30%; ไม่คืนเงินของเทอมนั้นหลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, các khoản phí được hoàn đầy đủ sau khi trừ phí hành chính xử lý hoàn tiền (kèm thư từ chối visa, nộp ít nhất 2 tuần trước khi kỳ học bắt đầu). Rút học >10 tuần trước kỳ học: hoàn toàn bộ; 6–10 tuần: 70%; 2–6 tuần: 50%; <2 tuần: 30%; không hoàn tiền cho kỳ đó sau khi khai giảng. Phí nộp hồ sơ không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，全额退还费用并扣除退款行政费（需提供拒签信，并在学期开始前至少 2 周提交）。学期开始前 >10 周退学：全额退款；6–10 周：70%；2–6 周：50%；<2 周：30%；开课后该学期不予退款。申请费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、返金事務手数料を差し引いて全額返金されます（ビザ却下通知書を学期開始の少なくとも2週間前までに提出）。学期開始の10週間超前の取り下げ：全額返金。6〜10週間前：70%。2〜6週間前：50%。2週間未満：30%。開始後はその学期の返金はありません。出願料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 환불 행정비를 공제한 후 비용이 전액 환불됩니다(비자 거절 서신을 학기 시작 최소 2주 전에 제출). 학기 시작 10주 초과 전 철회 시: 전액 환불, 6–10주: 70%, 2–6주: 50%, 2주 미만: 30%, 개강 후에는 해당 학기에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃត្រូវបានសងវិញទាំងស្រុង ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាលសម្រាប់ការសងប្រាក់វិញ (ជាមួយលិខិតបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ ដែលដាក់ជូនយ៉ាងហោចណាស់ 2 សប្តាហ៍មុនឆមាសចាប់ផ្តើម)។ ការដកខ្លួន >10 សប្តាហ៍មុនឆមាស៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង; 6–10 សប្តាហ៍៖ 70%; 2–6 សប្តាហ៍៖ 50%; <2 សប្តាហ៍៖ 30%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់ឆមាសនោះក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Visa ditolak sebelum mulai: refund biaya kuliah dipotong 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil), biaya materi ikut dikembalikan, wajib bukti penolakan. Mundur ≥28 hari sebelum mulai: refund biaya kuliah dikurangi AUD 500; kurang dari 28 hari atau setelah mulai: tidak ada refund; biaya enrolment tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: all tuition fees received refunded minus the lesser of 5% of total course fees or AUD 500; material fees refunded; no other admin fee. No refund if fraud/false information. After start: unused tuition only (material fees non-refundable). Evidence of refusal plus Fee Refund Application Form required; refund within 28 days of receiving them.
items.withdraw_before_start: 28 or more days before start: all tuition fees refunded less AUD 500 administration fee; less than 28 days: no tuition refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No fees refunded (including withdrawing from an ART visa refusal review to cancel enrolment).
items.non_refundable: Enrolment fee (all cases); non-tuition fees such as materials, CoE reissue, credit transfer application fees (except where visa is cancelled before start); AUD 500 admin fee on cancellations before start. Overseas bank/remittance/exchange fees deducted.
items.provider_default: Course not starting on designated day or cancelled after start: if start date moved more than 14 days, full refund of course fees; if cancelled after start, unused tuition refunded; within 14 days of application; otherwise Tuition Protection Service.
items.document: Fee Refund Policy (NVR Education Australia, CRICOS 03794C, RTO 45529). Note: NVR website lists Level 7, 191-199 Thomas St, Haymarket, not the input address (770-772 George St). - Issued 05/12/2025 (no version number)
items.summary_en: Visa refused before start: tuition refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less), material fees also refunded; proof of refusal required. Withdrawal ≥28 days before start: tuition refunded minus AUD 500; less than 28 days or after start: no refund; the enrolment fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) และคืนค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียนด้วย; ต้องมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธ ถอนตัว ≥28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเล่าเรียนหัก AUD 500; น้อยกว่า 28 วันหรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน; ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng: hoàn học phí trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn), phí tài liệu cũng được hoàn; cần có bằng chứng bị từ chối. Rút học ≥28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn học phí trừ AUD 500; dưới 28 ngày hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền; phí ghi danh không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 开课前签证被拒：退还学费并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准），教材费也予退还；需提供拒签证明。开课前 ≥28 天退学：退还学费并扣除 AUD 500；不足 28 天或开课后：不予退款；注册费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合：授業料から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金し、教材費も返金。却下の証明が必要です。開始の28日以上前の取り下げ：授業料からAUD 500を差し引いて返金。28日未満または開始後：返金なし。入学金は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자 거절 시: 수업료에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, 교재비도 환불됩니다. 거절 증빙이 필요합니다. 개강 28일 이상 전 철회 시: 수업료에서 AUD 500 공제 후 환불, 28일 미만 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ថ្លៃសម្ភារៈក៏ត្រូវបានសងវិញដែរ; ត្រូវមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ AUD 500; តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ; ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀនមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Global Training Innovations Pty Ltd T/A Oceania College of Technology (OCT)
items.summary_id: Visa ditolak: refund dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil), wajib surat penolakan Home Affairs. Mundur >12 minggu sebelum mulai refund penuh, 4–12 minggu 75%, <4 minggu 50% (masing-masing dikurangi 10% atau AUD 1.000, mana yang lebih kecil); setelah mulai tidak ada refund untuk periode berjalan; application fee dan materi yang sudah diterima tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Fails to start due to visa refusal: course fees paid minus the lesser of 5% of fees received before the default day or $500. Refused after commencement: pro-rated tuition refund minus the lesser of 5% or $500. Copy of Home Affairs refusal letter required, otherwise calculated as a standard withdrawal. Time limit not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 12 weeks before start: full tuition refund less the lesser of 10% or $1,000 (admin). More than 4 but less than 12 weeks: 75% of tuition paid less lesser of 10%/$1,000. Less than 4 weeks: 50% of tuition paid less lesser of 10%/$1,000. 48-hour cooling-off period: full refund of initial tuition paid.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund for current or previous study periods; prepaid fees for future study periods refunded in full less the lesser of 10% or $1,000. Non-commencement treated as withdrawal after start.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment administration/application fees once place confirmed (unless OCT cancels course); resource/materials fees for items already issued; tuition for services delivered; no refund if offer withdrawn due to incorrect/fraudulent information.
items.provider_default: Within 14 days of default day: alternative course at OCT's expense or refund of all unspent prepaid tuition; TPS steps in if OCT cannot.
items.document: Overseas Student Handbook - Section 6 Refunds - Version 2.0 (file uploaded Oct 2025)
items.summary_en: Visa refused: refund minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less); Home Affairs refusal letter required. Withdrawal >12 weeks before start: full refund; 4–12 weeks: 75%; <4 weeks: 50% (each minus 10% or AUD 1,000, whichever is less); no refund for the current period after start; the application fee and materials already received are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: วีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ: คืนเงินหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); ต้องมีจดหมายปฏิเสธจาก Home Affairs ถอนตัว >12 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวน; 4–12 สัปดาห์: 75%; <4 สัปดาห์: 50% (แต่ละกรณีหัก 10% หรือ AUD 1,000 แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); ไม่คืนเงินของช่วงเวลาปัจจุบันหลังเริ่มเรียน; ไม่คืนค่าสมัครและค่าอุปกรณ์การเรียนที่ได้รับไปแล้ว ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Visa bị từ chối: hoàn tiền sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn); cần có thư từ chối của Home Affairs. Rút học >12 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ; 4–12 tuần: 75%; <4 tuần: 50% (mỗi mức đều trừ 10% hoặc AUD 1,000, tùy số nào thấp hơn); không hoàn tiền cho kỳ hiện tại sau khi khai giảng; phí nộp hồ sơ và tài liệu đã nhận không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 签证被拒：退款扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）；需提供 Home Affairs 拒签信。开课前 >12 周退学：全额退款；4–12 周：75%；<4 周：50%（均扣除 10% 或 AUD 1,000，以较低者为准）；开课后当期不予退款；申请费及已领取的教材不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合：5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金。Home Affairsの却下通知書が必要です。開始の12週間超前の取り下げ：全額返金。4〜12週間前：75%。4週間未満：50%（いずれも10%またはAUD 1,000のいずれか少ない方を差し引き）。開始後は当該期間の返金はありません。出願料と受領済みの教材は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자 거절 시: 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불되며, Home Affairs 거절 서신이 필요합니다. 개강 12주 초과 전 철회 시: 전액 환불, 4–12주: 75%, 4주 미만: 50%(각각 10% 또는 AUD 1,000 중 적은 금액 공제), 개강 후에는 현재 기간에 대해 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비와 이미 수령한 교재는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ៖ សងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); ត្រូវមានលិខិតបដិសេធពី Home Affairs។ ការដកខ្លួន >12 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង; 4–12 សប្តាហ៍៖ 75%; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ 50% (នីមួយៗដកចេញ 10% ឬ AUD 1,000 យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញសម្រាប់រយៈពេលបច្ចុប្បន្នក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ; ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ និងសម្ភារៈដែលបានទទួលរួចហើយ មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak, semua biaya dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil) dengan bukti penolakan visa. Mundur sebelum mulai: >12 minggu 50%, 4–12 minggu 20%, <4 minggu 10% dari tuition prabayar; setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Application fee dan biaya layanan (airport pick-up, dll.) umumnya tidak dikembalikan; kebijakan Ozford College (sekolah) dan ELICOS berbeda. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: All course fees received before the student default day (including non-tuition fees) refunded minus the lesser of 5% of course fees or AUD 500. Requires written refund request plus proof of refusal from the Australian Government; paid within four weeks of the student default day. No refund if refusal based on false/misleading statements (per earlier v6.2).
items.withdraw_before_start: Refund of prepaid tuition by notice: more than 12 weeks before commencement - 50%; 4 to 12 weeks - 20%; less than 4 weeks - 10%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund of fees paid in advance for the course.
items.non_refundable: Application fees generally non-refundable; airport pick-up and other service fees non-refundable if request lodged less than 14 days before start, on/after start, or after the service is provided.
items.provider_default: Full refund of prepaid tuition within 14 days if course does not start; refund of unspent tuition within 14 days if it stops before completion; or alternative course at no extra cost if accepted in writing; otherwise TPS.
items.document: International Student Fee Refund Policy - Ozford Institute of Higher Education Pty Ltd (CRICOS 03429B) - Version 7.0, June 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused, all fees are refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less) with proof of visa refusal. Withdrawal before start: >12 weeks 50%, 4–12 weeks 20%, <4 weeks 10% of prepaid tuition; no refund after start. The application fee and service fees (airport pick-up, etc.) are generally not refunded; Ozford College (school) and ELICOS policies differ. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธ จะคืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) เมื่อมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัวก่อนเริ่มเรียน: >12 สัปดาห์ 50%, 4–12 สัปดาห์ 20%, <4 สัปดาห์ 10% ของค่าเล่าเรียนที่ชำระล่วงหน้า; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน โดยทั่วไปไม่คืนค่าสมัครและค่าบริการ (ค่าบริการรับที่สนามบิน ฯลฯ); นโยบายของ Ozford College (โรงเรียน) และ ELICOS แตกต่างกัน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối, toàn bộ các khoản phí được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn) kèm bằng chứng bị từ chối visa. Rút học trước khi khai giảng: >12 tuần 50%, 4–12 tuần 20%, <4 tuần 10% học phí đã đóng trước; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Phí nộp hồ sơ và phí dịch vụ (đón sân bay, v.v.) thông thường không được hoàn; chính sách của Ozford College (trường phổ thông) và ELICOS khác nhau. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如签证被拒，凭拒签证明退还全部费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前退学：>12 周退还预付学费的 50%，4–12 周 20%，<4 周 10%；开课后不予退款。申请费和服务费（接机等）一般不予退还；Ozford College（中学）与 ELICOS 的政策有所不同。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: ビザが却下された場合、ビザ却下の証明があれば、全費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始前の取り下げ：前払い授業料の、12週間超前は50%、4〜12週間前は20%、4週間未満は10%。開始後の返金はありません。出願料とサービス料（空港送迎など）は原則として返金されません。Ozford College（スクール）とELICOSではポリシーが異なります。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 비자가 거절된 경우, 비자 거절 증빙을 제출하면 모든 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 전 철회 시: 선납 수업료의 12주 초과 50%, 4–12주 20%, 4주 미만 10% 환불, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비와 서비스 비용(공항 픽업 등)은 일반적으로 환불되지 않으며, Ozford College(학교)와 ELICOS의 규정이 다릅니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ដោយមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួនមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ >12 សប្តាហ៍ 50%, 4–12 សប្តាហ៍ 20%, <4 សប្តាហ៍ 10% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាដែលបានបង់ជាមុន; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ និងថ្លៃសេវា (សេវាទទួលពីព្រលានយន្តហោះ ជាដើម) ជាទូទៅមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ; គោលនយោបាយរបស់ Ozford College (សាលា) និង ELICOS មានភាពខុសគ្នា។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Rosehill College, CRICOS 03622A, RTO 41257, Level 2 & 4, 616-620 Harris St Ultimo
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, semua biaya dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur ≥4 minggu sebelum mulai: semua biaya kembali kecuali biaya aplikasi; <4 minggu: 90% kembali; setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Biaya aplikasi tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: If student does not start (or withdraws on/before the agreed start day) because of visa refusal: total fees received minus 5% of course fees or AUD 500, whichever is less. Visa refused after commencement: no refund (fees for full study period payable). Refund application within 10 working days of the event.
items.withdraw_before_start: Up to 4 weeks before commencement: all fees refunded except application fee. Less than 4 weeks before commencement: 90% of all other fees refunded; application fee not refunded. Not starting on agreed date without having withdrawn: no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund; fees for the full study period (term) payable.
items.non_refundable: Application fee (amount not stated), except if the College cancels the course. No refund for cancellation due to disciplinary action, visa breach, or incorrect information.
items.provider_default: Cancelled before commencement: full refund of all fees; after commencement: refund of unspent fees (weekly tuition fee x weeks in default period). Students notified in writing within 3 working days; refund automatic within 10 working days.
items.document: RTO Management System - CRICOS and ELICOS Pack (Policies and Procedures / Student Handbook) - Refund policy - V2.1 (date not stated)
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, all fees are refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less). Withdrawal ≥4 weeks before start: all fees refunded except the application fee; <4 weeks: 90% refunded; no refund after start. The application fee is not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัว ≥4 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนค่าเรียนทั้งหมดยกเว้นค่าสมัคร; <4 สัปดาห์: คืน 90%; ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ไม่คืนค่าสมัคร ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, toàn bộ các khoản phí được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học ≥4 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ các khoản phí trừ phí nộp hồ sơ; <4 tuần: hoàn 90%; không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Phí nộp hồ sơ không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，退还全部费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前 ≥4 周退学：退还除申请费外的全部费用；<4 周：退还 90%；开课后不予退款。申请费不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、全費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始の4週間以上前の取り下げ：出願料を除く全費用を返金。4週間未満：90%を返金。開始後の返金はありません。出願料は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 모든 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 4주 이상 전 철회 시: 지원비를 제외한 모든 비용 환불, 4주 미만: 90% 환불, 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 지원비는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង)។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥4 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ ថ្លៃទាំងអស់ត្រូវបានសងវិញ លើកលែងតែថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យ; <4 សប្តាហ៍៖ សងវិញ 90%; មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ ថ្លៃដាក់ពាក្យមិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.official_name: Rosewood International College Pty Ltd (as named in the policy; One U Education listing shows Sunway International College Pty Ltd)
items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, Rosewood mengembalikan biaya kuliah (dokumen juga menyebut potongan 5% atau $500, mana yang lebih kecil). Mundur lebih dari 28 hari sebelum mulai mendapat 80% biaya kuliah awal dikurangi biaya admin $200 (kurang dari 28 hari: 50%), dan setelah mulai tidak ada refund. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Visa rejected before start: full tuition refund (excluding accommodation arrangement and airport pickup fees) with evidence; the policy also states refund = course fees received minus the lesser of 5% or $500 (ESOS 2024 Instrument) - the two statements differ. After start: not stated.
items.withdraw_before_start: More than 28 days before commencement: 80% of initial tuition fees less $200 administration fee. Less than 28 days: 50% of tuition paid (up to 24 weeks) less $200 administration fee; fees beyond that refunded 100%.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund once studies have commenced; no refund if cancelled for visa-condition breach.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment application fee; accommodation arrangement fee; airport pickup fee; homestay/airport transfer fees once arranged; agent fees; $200 administration fee deducted on withdrawals.
items.provider_default: If the institute cancels the course: 100% of fees paid refunded (tuition, accommodation, OSHC, enrolment application, accommodation arrangement and pickup fees); otherwise referred to TPS.
items.document: Refund Policy for International Students - Version 2.0; file dated 19 February 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, Rosewood refunds tuition fees (the document also mentions a deduction of 5% or $500, whichever is less). Withdrawal more than 28 days before start: 80% of initial tuition minus a $200 admin fee (less than 28 days: 50%); no refund after start. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน Rosewood จะคืนค่าเล่าเรียน (เอกสารยังระบุถึงการหัก 5% หรือ $500 แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) ถอนตัวมากกว่า 28 วันก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืน 80% ของค่าเล่าเรียนงวดแรกหักค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ $200 (น้อยกว่า 28 วัน: 50%); ไม่คืนเงินหลังเริ่มเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, Rosewood hoàn học phí (tài liệu cũng đề cập khoản khấu trừ 5% hoặc $500, tùy số nào thấp hơn). Rút học hơn 28 ngày trước khi khai giảng: hoàn 80% học phí ban đầu trừ phí hành chính $200 (dưới 28 ngày: 50%); không hoàn tiền sau khi khai giảng. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，Rosewood 退还学费（文件中也提到扣除 5% 或 $500，以较低者为准）。开课前超过 28 天退学：退还首期学费的 80% 并扣除 $200 行政费（不足 28 天：50%）；开课后不予退款。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、Rosewoodは授業料を返金します（書類には5%または$500のいずれか少ない方を差し引くとの記載もあります）。開始の28日超前の取り下げ：初回授業料の80%から$200の事務手数料を差し引き（28日未満：50%）。開始後の返金はありません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, Rosewood는 수업료를 환불합니다(문서에는 5% 또는 $500 중 적은 금액의 공제도 언급되어 있습니다). 개강 28일 초과 전 철회 시: 초기 수업료의 80%에서 $200 행정비 공제(28일 미만: 50%), 개강 후에는 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន Rosewood សងថ្លៃសិក្សាវិញ (ឯកសារក៏បានលើកឡើងអំពីការកាត់ 5% ឬ $500 យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាងផងដែរ)។ ការដកខ្លួនច្រើនជាង 28 ថ្ងៃមុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ 80% នៃថ្លៃសិក្សាដំបូង ដកចេញថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល $200 (តិចជាង 28 ថ្ងៃ៖ 50%); មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញក្រោយពេលចូលរៀនទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។

items.summary_id: Jika visa ditolak sebelum mulai, biaya kursus dikembalikan dikurangi 5% atau AUD 500 (mana yang lebih kecil) dengan bukti penolakan visa. Mundur ≥10 minggu sebelum mulai: refund penuh dikurangi 10% atau AUD 1.000 (mana yang lebih kecil), 4–10 minggu: 50%, <4 minggu atau setelah mulai: tidak ada refund. Biaya enrolment/admin dan non-tuition tidak dikembalikan. Yang berlaku adalah written agreement/offer letter sekolah.
items.visa_refused: Before course start: full refund of course fees less 5% of amount paid or AUD 500, whichever is lower; authenticated evidence of visa refusal required; enrolment/admin, registration and other non-tuition fees not refunded. After start: refund of unspent tuition paid to date. No refund if visa cancelled for breach or extension refused for not meeting requirements.
items.withdraw_before_start: Written notice at least 10 weeks before start: full course fee refund less the lower of 10% of tuition paid or AUD 1,000. More than 4 and up to 10 weeks: 50% of tuition initially received. Less than 4 weeks: no refund.
items.withdraw_after_start: No refund.
items.non_refundable: Enrolment/admin fees, registration fees and other non-tuition fees; debts owed to SHIC deducted from refunds.
items.provider_default: Student may choose refund of unspent tuition within 14 days of course ceasing (procedure section says 10 working days) or placement in an alternative course; otherwise TPS.
items.document: Fees & Refund Policy (OS2.6.01.01) - Angel Investments Group Pty Ltd t/a Sacred Heart International College (CRICOS 03606A per website) - Version 1.1, approved March 2026
items.summary_en: If the visa is refused before start, course fees are refunded minus 5% or AUD 500 (whichever is less) with proof of visa refusal. Withdrawal ≥10 weeks before start: full refund minus 10% or AUD 1,000 (whichever is less); 4–10 weeks: 50%; <4 weeks or after start: no refund. Enrolment/admin fees and non-tuition fees are not refunded. The school's written agreement/offer letter applies.
items.summary_th: หากวีซ่าถูกปฏิเสธก่อนเริ่มเรียน จะคืนค่าหลักสูตรหักออก 5% หรือ AUD 500 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า) เมื่อมีหลักฐานการถูกปฏิเสธวีซ่า ถอนตัว ≥10 สัปดาห์ก่อนเริ่มเรียน: คืนเต็มจำนวนหัก 10% หรือ AUD 1,000 (แล้วแต่จำนวนใดน้อยกว่า); 4–10 สัปดาห์: 50%; <4 สัปดาห์หรือหลังเริ่มเรียน: ไม่คืนเงิน ไม่คืนค่าลงทะเบียนเรียน/ค่าธรรมเนียมดำเนินการ และค่าใช้จ่ายที่ไม่ใช่ค่าเล่าเรียน ให้ยึดตาม written agreement/Offer Letter ของโรงเรียน
items.summary_vi: Nếu visa bị từ chối trước khi khai giảng, học phí khóa học được hoàn sau khi trừ 5% hoặc AUD 500 (tùy số nào thấp hơn) kèm bằng chứng bị từ chối visa. Rút học ≥10 tuần trước khi khai giảng: hoàn toàn bộ trừ 10% hoặc AUD 1,000 (tùy số nào thấp hơn); 4–10 tuần: 50%; <4 tuần hoặc sau khi khai giảng: không hoàn tiền. Phí ghi danh/hành chính và các khoản phí ngoài học phí không được hoàn. Áp dụng theo written agreement/Offer Letter của trường.
items.summary_zh: 如开课前签证被拒，凭拒签证明退还课程费用并扣除 5% 或 AUD 500（以较低者为准）。开课前 ≥10 周退学：全额退款并扣除 10% 或 AUD 1,000（以较低者为准）；4–10 周：50%；<4 周或开课后：不予退款。注册/行政费和非学费费用不予退还。以学校的 written agreement/Offer Letter 为准。
items.summary_ja: 開始前にビザが却下された場合、ビザ却下の証明があれば、コース費用から5%またはAUD 500（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて返金されます。開始の10週間以上前の取り下げ：10%またはAUD 1,000（いずれか少ない方）を差し引いて全額返金。4〜10週間前：50%。4週間未満または開始後：返金なし。入学金/事務手数料と授業料以外の費用は返金されません。学校の written agreement/Offer Letter が適用されます。
items.summary_ko: 개강 전 비자가 거절된 경우, 비자 거절 증빙을 제출하면 코스 비용에서 5% 또는 AUD 500(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제한 후 환불됩니다. 개강 10주 이상 전 철회 시: 10% 또는 AUD 1,000(둘 중 적은 금액)을 공제하고 전액 환불, 4–10주: 50%, 4주 미만 또는 개강 후: 환불되지 않습니다. 입학금/행정비와 수업료 외 비용은 환불되지 않습니다. 학교의 written agreement/Offer Letter가 적용됩니다.
items.summary_km: ប្រសិនបើទិដ្ឋាការត្រូវបានបដិសេធមុនពេលចូលរៀន ថ្លៃវគ្គសិក្សាត្រូវបានសងវិញ ដកចេញ 5% ឬ AUD 500 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង) ដោយមានភស្តុតាងនៃការបដិសេធទិដ្ឋាការ។ ការដកខ្លួន ≥10 សប្តាហ៍មុនពេលចូលរៀន៖ សងវិញទាំងស្រុង ដកចេញ 10% ឬ AUD 1,000 (យកមួយណាដែលតិចជាង); 4–10 សប្តាហ៍៖ 50%; <4 សប្តាហ៍ ឬក្រោយពេលចូលរៀន៖ មិនមានការសងប្រាក់វិញទេ។ ថ្លៃចុះឈ្មោះចូលរៀន/ថ្លៃរដ្ឋបាល និងថ្លៃមិនមែនថ្លៃសិក្សា មិនត្រូវបានសងវិញទេ។ អនុវត្តតាម written agreement/Offer Letter របស់សាលា។
